constraints.regle: The business use case (rationale, problem addressed, expected value) is formalized in a document validated by the business sponsor, prior to or concurrent with the project's start.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a scoping document (scoping note, mandate, pitch) describing the problem addressed and the expected value, and verify its formal validation by the business sponsor.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Use case scoping document + proof of validation (signature, committee minutes, approval e-mail).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = scoping document exists and is validated by the sponsor ; partial = document exists but not formally validated ; non-compliant = no formalized use case
actions_audit: Request the use case scoping document and verify that it covers the rationale, the problem addressed, and the expected value.
Verify the trace of validation by the business sponsor (signature, minutes, e-mail).
If gap: have the use case formalized and organize its validation before continuing the technical audit.

constraints.regle: The application's target users are identified and characterized by at least one documented persona per significant usage profile.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of persona sheets or an equivalent characterization (profile, needs, frequency of use, level of autonomy) for each significant user profile, and their consistency with actually observed users.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Persona sheets or equivalent document + observed usage data (active users, frequency) if available.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = personas documented for all significant profiles and consistent with observed usage ; partial = partial personas or not compared against actual usage ; non-compliant = no documented persona
actions_audit: Request the persona sheets or equivalent user documentation; verify their coverage of usage profiles.
Compare the declared personas against actual usage data if available (active users, features used).
If gap: have the missing personas formalized based on representative user interviews.
standards: TOGAF — ADM Phase B (architecture métier, acteurs et rôles)

constraints.regle: Structuring business rules (calculations, thresholds, business authorizations, special cases) are documented in a repository validated by the business, separate from the source code.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a business rules document covering the application's structuring rules, and its validation by a business representative; spot-check the consistency between documented rules and implemented rules.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Validated business rules document (signed or pending signature) + code excerpts illustrating 2-3 rules for cross-checking.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = rules documented, validated, and consistent with the code on the sample checked ; partial = rules documented but not validated or partially consistent ; non-compliant = implicit business rules, known only from the code
actions_audit: Request the business rules document and verify its coverage of structuring cases and special cases.
Select a sample of rules and verify their consistency with the actual implementation (code, configuration).
If gap: have the rules repository completed/validated and correct the identified inconsistencies.
standards: COBIT 2019 — BAI02 (gérer la définition des exigences)

constraints.regle: The application's expected value is translated into measurable business indicators (KPIs), each with a baseline value and a target.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of formalized business indicators with a calculation method, baseline value, and target, and verify that they are actually measured (dashboard, extraction, measurement log).
constraints.preuve_attendue: Dashboard or KPI document with baseline and observed values + calculation method.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = KPIs defined, measured, with baseline and target ; partial = KPIs defined but not measured or without a baseline ; non-compliant = no business KPI defined
actions_audit: Request the list of business KPIs and their calculation method; verify the existence of a baseline value and a target.
Verify the freshness and reliability of the measurements produced (source, last update date).
If gap: have the missing KPIs defined and instrument their automated measurement.

constraints.regle: The functional scope covered by the application is bounded by an explicit list of exclusions (out-of-scope items), communicated to stakeholders.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a documented list of functional out-of-scope items and its actual communication to stakeholders (sponsor, users, dependent teams).
constraints.preuve_attendue: Scope document including an explicit out-of-scope section + proof of distribution (minutes, shared material).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = out-of-scope items documented and communicated ; partial = out-of-scope items documented but not distributed ; non-compliant = no explicit delineation of out-of-scope items
actions_audit: Request the scope documentation and verify the presence of an explicit out-of-scope section.
Verify that the out-of-scope items were communicated to and understood by the relevant stakeholders (quick interview).
If gap: have the list of scope exclusions formalized and distributed.
standards: TOGAF — ADM Phase A (délimitation du périmètre)

constraints.regle: Product governance relies on a structured backlog, an explicit prioritization mechanism, and regular governance rituals (review, arbitration).
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of an up-to-date product backlog, a documented prioritization method, and the actual holding of governance rituals (frequency, participants, tracked decisions).
constraints.preuve_attendue: Product backlog excerpt + prioritization method + minutes of governance rituals over a representative period.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = structured backlog, documented prioritization, rituals held and tracked ; partial = backlog exists without a prioritization method or irregular rituals ; non-compliant = no backlog or product governance
actions_audit: Request access to the product backlog and verify its structure (status, priority, value).
Verify that product governance rituals were held over recent periods (minutes, decisions).
If gap: recommend implementing a structured backlog and a regular prioritization ritual.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion du portefeuille

constraints.regle: The application's business value is demonstrated by measured results (adoption, gains, return on investment), not merely projected.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of measured results (actual usage, qualitative/quantitative gains, user feedback) and their comparison against the initial value hypotheses.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Value assessment (measured results vs. initial hypotheses) + observed usage or gains data.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = value demonstrated by measured results compared against the initial hypotheses ; partial = initial results available but incomplete or not compared against the hypotheses ; non-compliant = value only projected, no measured result
actions_audit: Request the value assessment and the usage or gains data observed since release.
Compare the measured results against the value hypotheses formulated at the outset.
If gap: have value measurement organized (instrumentation, user survey) before the industrialization decision.

constraints.regle: Critical functional journeys (those whose failure would compromise business value) are formalized and validated with representative users.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a formalization of the critical journeys (storyboard, user journey, process) and their validation by representative users or the business.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Formalized functional journey document + proof of user validation (test, workshop, documented feedback).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = critical journeys formalized and validated by representative users ; partial = journeys formalized in fragments or not validated ; non-compliant = critical journeys not documented
actions_audit: Identify the critical functional journeys with the business and request their existing formalization.
Verify the trace of a validation by representative users (workshop, test, feedback collected).
If gap: have the missing critical journeys formalized and validated before the industrialization decision.

constraints.regle: The project's structuring assumptions and business risks are recorded in a living register, with a mitigation plan for each significant risk.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a register of business assumptions and risks, its recent update, and the presence of a mitigation plan for significant risks.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Dated register of business assumptions/risks + mitigation plan associated with significant risks.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = register up to date with mitigation plans for all significant risks ; partial = register exists but not updated or partial mitigation ; non-compliant = no register of business assumptions or risks
actions_audit: Request the register of business assumptions and risks and verify its last update date.
Verify the existence of a mitigation plan for each risk rated as significant.
If gap: have the register established and prioritize the missing mitigation plans.

constraints.regle: The application has an up-to-date map of its components, flows, and internal dependencies, referenced in the information system inventory.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of an application map (components, flows, dependencies) and its last update date; verify its consistency with the actually deployed architecture.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Dated application mapping diagram or document + excerpt from the information system inventory.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = map up to date (< 6 months) and consistent with what is deployed ; partial = map exists but outdated or partially consistent ; non-compliant = no application map
actions_audit: Request the application map and verify its last update date.
Compare the declared map against the actually deployed architecture (sample of components).
If gap: have the map produced or updated and recorded in the information system inventory.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion des configurations de service

constraints.regle: Application components exhibit low coupling and high cohesion; component boundaries are aligned with distinct business responsibilities.
constraints.verification: Analyze the breakdown of components (modules, services) and assess their coupling (cross dependencies, state sharing) with respect to the business responsibilities they carry.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Code or configuration excerpts illustrating component boundaries + diagram of inter-component dependencies.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = low coupling, boundaries aligned with clear business responsibilities ; partial = moderate coupling or partially consistent boundaries ; non-compliant = widespread strong coupling, unidentifiable boundaries
actions_audit: Analyze inter-component dependencies (imports, calls, database sharing) and map the actual coupling.
Compare the observed component boundaries against the expected business responsibilities.
If gap: recommend a decoupling plan prioritized on the most coupled components.

constraints.regle: Architecture choices (components, patterns, services) comply with the internal reference catalog; any deviation is identified and justified.
constraints.verification: Compare the components and patterns used against the internal reference catalog (approved services, recommended patterns) and record the deviations.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Compliance matrix against the reference catalog + documented justification for each identified deviation.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% of choices compliant with the catalog or deviations justified and validated ; partial = deviations identified but not justified/validated ; non-compliant = choices outside the catalog not recorded
actions_audit: Establish the list of components and patterns used and compare them against the internal reference catalog.
For each identified deviation, verify the existence of a justification and a validation by the decision-making authority.
If an unjustified deviation exists: have it migrated to the catalog or initiate the exception validation procedure.
standards: TOGAF — ADM Phase G (revue de conformité architecturale)

constraints.regle: The application has distinct, segregated environments (development, test, production at a minimum), with a documented promotion chain and an explicit transfer of responsibility.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence and actual segregation of the required environments, and the existence of a documented procedure for promotion between environments with transfer of responsibility.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Inventory of environments with their segregation + documented promotion procedure.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = segregated environments and a documented, followed promotion procedure ; partial = environments present but segregation or procedure incomplete ; non-compliant = single environment or no segregation
actions_audit: Identify the existing environments and verify their segregation (access, data, configuration).
Verify the existence and actual application of a promotion procedure between environments.
If gap: have the missing environments created and formalize the promotion chain.
standards: DORA (Accelerate) — capacité de gestion des environnements de test et de déploiement
ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion des déploiements

constraints.regle: Critical architecture components have no unidentified and unmitigated single point of failure (SPOF); resilience mechanisms (redundancy, failover, rollback) are documented and tested.
constraints.verification: Identify the architecture's critical components and verify for each the existence of a resilience mechanism (redundancy, failover, rollback strategy) and proof of a recent test of that mechanism.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Map of critical components with associated resilience mechanism + resilience or rollback test report.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = SPOFs identified and mitigated, resilience mechanisms tested ; partial = SPOFs identified but mitigation not tested ; non-compliant = SPOF not identified or not mitigated on a critical component
actions_audit: Map the critical components and identify potential single points of failure.
Verify the existence and recent testing of resilience mechanisms (redundancy, failover, rollback) for each identified SPOF.
If gap: prioritize the mitigation of critical SPOFs before any industrialization decision.
standards: DORA (Accelerate) — fiabilité et délai de rétablissement

constraints.regle: Architectural debt (deviations from target principles, technical workarounds) is identified, qualified, and tracked in a prioritized register.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of an architectural debt register, the qualification of each item (impact, effort), and its tracking over time.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Dated architectural debt register with qualification and remediation status.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = debt recorded, qualified, and tracked with a prioritized remediation plan ; partial = debt identified but not qualified or not tracked ; non-compliant = no identification of architectural debt
actions_audit: Request the architectural debt register and verify the qualification (impact, effort) of each item.
Verify the existence of a prioritized remediation plan and its actual progress.
If gap: have the unidentified debt recorded and integrate its remediation into the remediation plan.
standards: COBIT 2019 — BAI03 (gérer l'identification et la construction des solutions)

constraints.regle: A target architecture diagram, formalized according to a standardized representation (components, flows, boundaries), is produced, up to date, and accessible to stakeholders.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a formalized architecture diagram (components, flows, boundaries, legend), its last update date, and its accessibility to the relevant stakeholders.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Dated target architecture diagram + proof of accessibility (shared location, documentation link).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = diagram exists, up to date, accessible, and compliant with the standardized representation ; partial = diagram exists but outdated or non-standardized ; non-compliant = no architecture diagram
actions_audit: Request the target architecture diagram and verify its compliance with the expected standardized representation (components, flows, boundaries).
Verify the last update date and its consistency with the actually deployed architecture.
If gap: have the diagram produced or updated and made accessible to stakeholders.
standards: ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022 — 5.3 (description d'architecture, vues et points de vue)

constraints.regle: The application's external dependencies (third-party services, shared components, upstream/downstream platforms) are inventoried along with their criticality and management approach.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of an inventory of external dependencies with their criticality level, owner, and management approach (contract, SLA, failover procedure).
constraints.preuve_attendue: Inventory of external dependencies with criticality, owner, and associated management approach.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = external dependencies inventoried, criticality qualified, and management approach defined ; partial = incomplete inventory or unqualified criticality ; non-compliant = no inventory of external dependencies
actions_audit: Request the inventory of external dependencies and verify its completeness by cross-checking against the actual architecture.
Verify the criticality qualification and the existence of a management approach for each critical dependency.
If gap: have the inventory completed and define the management approach for uncovered dependencies.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion des fournisseurs

constraints.regle: The architecture's sizing (compute, storage, network resources) is made explicit and justified with regard to a declared target load, with a documented margin.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a documented target load assumption and the justification of the sizing adopted (allocated resources, safety margin) with regard to that load.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Sizing document with target load assumptions, allocated resources, and retained margin.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = sizing documented, justified by an explicit target load and a reasonable margin ; partial = sizing exists but not justified or target load implicit ; non-compliant = no documented sizing
actions_audit: Request the target load assumptions and the associated sizing document.
Verify the consistency between the allocated resources, the declared target load, and the retained margin.
If gap: have the load assumptions formalized and adjust the sizing accordingly.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion de la capacité

constraints.regle: Structuring architecture decisions are tracked in a decision register (context, options considered, choice made, consequences), accessible and up to date.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of an architecture decision register covering the structuring choices, the presence of the expected fields (context, options, choice, consequences), and its update upon major changes; a format check can verify the structure of the entries.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Architecture decision register with, for a sample, context/options/choice/consequences filled in.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = structuring decisions tracked, complete, and up to date ; partial = register exists but incomplete or outdated ; non-compliant = no traceability of architecture decisions
actions_audit: Request the architecture decision register and verify its structure on a sample.
Compare known structuring decisions (tech lead interviews) against their actual presence in the register.
If gap: have the missing decisions tracked retroactively and establish the traceability discipline for subsequent ones.

constraints.regle: The shared platform / application workload zoning is documented in the map and watertight: no application resource resides within the platform zone's perimeter.
constraints.verification: Compare the zone map against the actual resource inventory; look for any application resource deployed within the platform's management perimeter.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Zone map + resource inventory by zone (dated extraction).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = complete and watertight zoning ; partial = zoning documented with tracked exceptions ; non-compliant = untracked mixing between platform and application
actions_audit: Request the zone map and the resource inventory; attach both.
Cross-check the inventory against the declared perimeter of the platform zone; list any deviation.
If gap: plan the migration of application resources out of the platform zone.

constraints.regle: No significant inter-application exchange bypasses the trusted exchange intermediary (API gateway, event bus); any exception is documented and dated.
constraints.verification: Inventory the inter-application flows (map + network configuration) and verify that they pass through the recorded trusted intermediary; identify direct links.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Map of inter-application flows with, for each, the observed passage point.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% of flows via the trusted intermediary or a tracked exception ; partial = a minority of direct links documented after the fact ; non-compliant = untracked direct links
actions_audit: Extract the list of the application's outbound/inbound integrations; attach the map.
Verify for each flow the actual passage point (configuration, access logs).
If gap: switch the flow to the profile's trusted intermediary or document the exception.

constraints.regle: No inter-organization file exchange transits outside the recorded trusted managed service (no ad hoc sharing: messaging, personal storage, removable media).
constraints.verification: Inventory the inbound/outbound file exchanges and their actual channel; look for ad hoc channels in the documentation, configurations, and interviews.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Inventory of file exchanges with the observed channel for each.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = all exchanges via the recorded managed service ; partial = ad hoc channels identified with a resolution plan ; non-compliant = untracked active ad hoc channels
actions_audit: List the file flows and their channel; attach the inventory.
Verify the managed service's configuration (traceability, encryption, access expiration).
If gap: migrate the flow to the managed service and close the ad hoc channel.

constraints.regle: Each deprecated API version carries a published and honored retirement deadline; no overdue version remains accessible.
constraints.verification: Extract the register of exposed API versions; verify for each deprecated version the existence of a published deadline and the actual inaccessibility of expired versions.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Version register with status/deadline + access test on expired versions.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = deadlines published and honored ; partial = published deadlines not met, with a plan ; non-compliant = deprecated versions accessible with no deadline
actions_audit: Request the register of API versions and their statuses; attach the excerpt.
Test access to a version announced as retired; attach the result.
If gap: publish the retirement deadline and cut off access to expired versions.

constraints.regle: A reversibility plan exists: export of all data and configurations in usable, documented formats, tested at least once.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of the reversibility plan, the documented export formats, and the trace of a complete export test.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Reversibility plan + inventory of exports (formats) + dated test report.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = plan documented and tested ; partial = plan documented but not tested ; non-compliant = no documented export capability
actions_audit: Request the reversibility plan and the export formats; attach.
Verify the date and scope of the last export test.
If gap: document the exports and schedule a reversibility test.

constraints.regle: An explicit map covers the ten risk categories of the current OWASP Top 10, each associated with at least one verified mitigation measure and its proof.
constraints.verification: Request the risk → mitigation → proof map; verify that no Top 10 category is left without an associated measure or proof.
constraints.preuve_attendue: OWASP Top 10 coverage table (category, measure, proof, verification date).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = 10 categories covered with proof ; partial = incomplete coverage or missing proofs ; non-compliant = no map
actions_audit: Request the OWASP Top 10 coverage map; verify its completeness against the current edition.
Sample 2-3 categories and verify the associated proof (test, configuration, code).
If gap: complete the map and schedule verification of the uncovered categories.
standards: OWASP ASVS 5.0 — V1 (Architecture, conception, threat modeling)

constraints.regle: Every external input (user input, API parameter, imported file) is validated and sanitized server-side according to an expected format model; client-side validation is never the sole barrier.
constraints.verification: Identify the exposed entry points (forms, API endpoints, file imports); verify the presence of systematic server-side validation (type, format, length, range) and the absence of any possible bypass from the client.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Code or validation configuration excerpts per entry point + result of a malformed input test rejected server-side.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = systematic server-side validation on all recorded entry points ; partial = partial or inconsistent validation ; non-compliant = no validation or client-side only
actions_audit: Identify the exposed entry points and verify the server-side validation associated with each.
Submit a malformed/malicious input to a representative entry point; verify its rejection and logging.
If gap: instrument the missing validation and remove any reliance on client-side validation alone.

constraints.regle: The project's direct and transitive dependencies are automatically scanned (SCA) at each significant change; any known, fixable critical or high vulnerability is subject to a dated remediation plan.
constraints.verification: Run or review the latest SCA scan for the technology profile; verify the absence of any critical/high vulnerability without a remediation plan and the scan's execution frequency.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Dated SCA scan report (list of CVEs, severity) + remediation plan for open vulnerabilities.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = recent scan, no critical/high CVE without a dated plan ; partial = high CVE with a plan but deadline exceeded ; non-compliant = critical CVE with no remediation or no scan
actions_audit: Run the SCA scan on the direct and transitive dependencies; attach the report.
Cross-check each critical/high CVE against a dated remediation plan and its owner.
If gap: update or isolate the vulnerable dependency and schedule the fix.
standards: OWASP Top 10 2021 — A06:2021 Vulnerable and Outdated Components
SLSA — niveau de provenance des builds

constraints.regle: Each exposed entry point applies a rate-limiting policy (quotas, throttling) proportionate to the expected usage, protecting against abuse and application-level denial of service.
constraints.verification: Identify the exposed entry points and their rate-limiting policy; test exceeding the quota and verify the controlled rejection response (code, message, logging).
constraints.preuve_attendue: Rate-limiting policy configuration per entry point + result of a quota-exceeding test.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = rate limiting active and tested on all exposed entry points ; partial = partial or untested rate limiting ; non-compliant = no rate limiting
actions_audit: Identify the exposed entry points and their declared rate-limiting policy.
Trigger a quota-exceeding condition in a test environment; verify the controlled rejection.
If gap: instrument the missing rate limiting and define the thresholds per entry point.
standards: OWASP ASVS 5.0 — V13 (API et services Web)

constraints.regle: Application sessions are protected against theft and replay (secure cookies, bounded expiration, identifier regeneration upon authentication), and any state-changing action is protected against cross-site request forgery (CSRF).
constraints.verification: Inspect the session cookie attributes (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite), the session lifetime, and the presence of an anti-CSRF token on state-changing actions; test a forged request without a valid token.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Session cookie configuration excerpts + result of the CSRF request test without a token (rejected).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = hardened cookies + systematic, verified CSRF token ; partial = partial hardening or token not verified everywhere ; non-compliant = unprotected session or no CSRF protection
actions_audit: Inspect the security attributes of the session cookies and the expiration policy.
Submit a state-changing request without a valid CSRF token; verify its rejection.
If gap: harden the cookies and extend CSRF protection to the relevant actions.
standards: OWASP Top 10 2021 — A01:2021 Broken Access Control

constraints.regle: HTTP responses carry security headers aligned with the state of the art (content security policy, strict transport, anti-sniffing protection, referrer policy) across all exposed routes.
constraints.verification: Analyze the HTTP response headers on a representative sample of exposed routes; verify their presence and their non-permissive configuration.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Analysis capture of the security headers on the exposed routes (technology profile tool).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = recommended headers present and non-permissive on all routes ; partial = partial or permissive headers ; non-compliant = no security headers
actions_audit: Analyze the HTTP security headers on a sample of exposed routes; attach the capture.
Verify the precise configuration of each header (non-permissive values).
If gap: configure the missing headers or strengthen the permissive values.

constraints.regle: No sensitive data (secret, personal data, authentication token) appears in clear text in the application logs; a redaction/masking mechanism applies before writing, regardless of the log level.
constraints.verification: Trigger a logged event including sensitive data in a test environment; inspect the resulting log to verify its actual masking.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Log excerpt showing masked sensitive data + configuration of the redaction mechanism.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = systematic redaction verified by test ; partial = partial redaction (some fields/levels not covered) ; non-compliant = sensitive data in clear text in the logs
actions_audit: Trigger, in a test, a logged event carrying a known sensitive data item; inspect the resulting log.
Verify the configuration of the redaction mechanism across all log levels and destinations.
If gap: instrument the missing redaction and purge the affected historical logs.
standards: OWASP Top 10 2021 — A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures

constraints.regle: A static scan (SAST) and a dynamic scan (DAST) run on every significant change in continuous integration, with a blocking pipeline failure on any critical vulnerability.
constraints.verification: Verify the SAST/DAST integration in the CI pipeline configuration and the recent execution history; confirm the blocking behavior on a critical vulnerability introduced in test.
constraints.preuve_attendue: CI pipeline configuration (SAST/DAST steps) + recent execution report + proof of blocking on a critical vulnerability.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = SAST and DAST active and blocking in CI ; partial = only one of the two scans active or non-blocking ; non-compliant = no security scan in CI
actions_audit: Verify the presence and execution frequency of the SAST/DAST steps in the CI pipeline; attach the configuration.
Introduce a canary vulnerability and verify the pipeline blocks; attach the proof.
If gap: integrate the missing scans and configure the blocking threshold.

constraints.regle: A formalized threat model covers the application's critical flows, assets, and trust boundaries, and is reviewed at every significant architectural change.
constraints.verification: Request the threat model and its last review date; verify its correspondence with the actually deployed architecture.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Dated threat model document + minutes of the last review and its trigger (architectural change).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = threat model up to date and covering the actual architecture ; partial = threat model exists but outdated ; non-compliant = no threat model
actions_audit: Request the threat model and verify its last review date.
Compare the threat model against the actually deployed architecture; note any coverage gaps.
If gap: produce or update the threat model and schedule its periodic review.

constraints.regle: The production configuration eliminates default settings, demo accounts, debug mode, and any service or feature that is not strictly necessary, in order to minimize the attack surface.
constraints.verification: Compare the production configuration against a hardening baseline; verify the absence of default accounts, active debug mode, and superfluous services.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Capture of the production configuration compared against the hardening baseline + list of deviations.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = configuration aligned with the hardening baseline, no deviation ; partial = minor documented deviations ; non-compliant = active debug mode or default accounts present in production
actions_audit: Compare the production configuration against the technology profile's hardening baseline; note the deviations.
Specifically verify the absence of active debug mode and default accounts.
If gap: apply the hardening baseline and remove the superfluous elements.

constraints.regle: Network egress is denied by default with an explicit list of allowed destinations; name resolution is governed and logged.
constraints.verification: Inspect the network egress rules (default deny, allow list) and the name resolution configuration; verify the logging of resolutions and denied egress attempts.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Export of the egress rules + name resolution configuration + log excerpt.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = default deny + allow list + logging all active ; partial = allow list without logging ; non-compliant = unrestricted network egress
actions_audit: Extract the effective network egress rules; attach the export.
Test an egress attempt to an unauthorized destination: it must be denied and logged.
If gap: establish the profile's default deny and allow list.

constraints.regle: Vulnerabilities in the runtime base and dependencies are continuously inventoried; critical patches are applied within a defined, measured, and tracked timeframe.
constraints.verification: Verify the continuous inventory of vulnerabilities (base + dependencies), the timeframe policy by severity, and the metrics for timeframe compliance.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Dated inventory report + timeframe policy + remediation metric (e.g., average critical timeframe).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = continuous inventory + timeframes met and measured ; partial = inventory without timeframe tracking ; non-compliant = no inventory of the production estate
actions_audit: Extract the current vulnerability inventory and its freshness; attach.
Verify the timeframe policy by severity and its compliance over the last 3 months.
If gap: tool the continuous inventory and establish the patching policy.

constraints.regle: A governed security program exists: named responsibilities, periodic team awareness training, security metrics tracked in review.
constraints.verification: Verify the designation of security responsibilities, the awareness plan and its last execution, and the existence of periodically reviewed metrics.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Organization chart/designations + awareness training trace + metrics review excerpt.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = responsibilities + awareness training + metrics all active ; partial = responsibilities without metrics ; non-compliant = no security governance
actions_audit: Identify the named security officers; attach the designation.
Collect the awareness plan/trace and the tracked metrics.
If gap: appoint responsible parties, schedule awareness training, define 3 starting metrics.
standards: OWASP SAMM — Governance (Strategy & Metrics, Education & Guidance)

constraints.regle: Authentication for all human access is delegated to a central identity provider, with MFA enabled.
constraints.verification: Verify the application's authentication configuration: delegation to the central IdP (no local application account outside the procedure), MFA required for all human access.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Capture of the authentication configuration + IdP MFA policy.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = IdP delegation + MFA proven ; partial = delegation without systematic MFA ; non-compliant = local authentication or no MFA
actions_audit: Inspect the authentication configuration (code + platform console); attach the capture.
Test access without MFA: it must be denied; document the result.
If gap: formulate the remediation action (IdP delegation, MFA activation).

constraints.regle: No secret (key, token, password, certificate) resides in the source code, the repository history, the versioned configuration, or the delivered artifacts.
constraints.verification: Run the technology profile's secrets scan on the repository's full history; verify the scan's integration in CI with a blocking failure.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Scan report (0 findings) on the full history + CI pipeline configuration.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = clean scan + active CI gate ; partial = clean scan without a CI gate ; non-compliant = ≥ 1 active secret detected
actions_audit: Run the secrets scan on the full history; attach the report.
Verify the pipeline fails when a canary secret is introduced; attach the proof.
If gap: revoke/rotate the exposed secrets, purge the history, connect the vault.

constraints.regle: Application secrets reside in a central vault; rotation ≤ 90 days; access log active.
constraints.verification: Inventory the application secrets and their location; verify the rotation policy and the activation of the vault's access log.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Inventory of secrets + capture of the rotation policy + access log excerpt.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = vault + rotation ≤ 90 days + active log ; partial = vault without governed rotation ; non-compliant = secrets outside the vault
actions_audit: List the secrets consumed by the application and their location; attach the inventory.
Verify the last rotation date of each secret; attach the capture.
If gap: migrate to the profile's vault and schedule the rotation.

constraints.regle: Applications authenticate via runtime identity (no static application secret) everywhere the platform allows it.
constraints.verification: Identify the inter-service authentications; verify the use of runtime identities rather than static secrets, and justify each exception.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Map of inter-service authentications with the mechanism used.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = runtime identities used wherever possible, exceptions justified ; partial = mixed with no justification ; non-compliant = static secrets widespread
actions_audit: Map the service-to-service links and their authentication mode.
For each remaining static secret, require justification of platform impossibility.
If gap: switch to the profile's runtime identity.

constraints.regle: Authorization is based on documented roles (RBAC); access is reviewed at least every 6 months.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a documented roles/permissions matrix and the trace of the last access review (< 6 months).
constraints.preuve_attendue: RBAC matrix + dated minutes of the last access review.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = matrix up to date + review < 6 months ; partial = matrix without a recent review ; non-compliant = no role model
actions_audit: Request the roles/permissions matrix; verify its correspondence with the actual configuration.
Verify the date and scope of the last access review.
If gap: establish the matrix and schedule the periodic review.

constraints.regle: Technical accounts are dedicated, not shared, granted minimal privileges, and distinct from human accounts.
constraints.verification: Inventory the technical accounts used; verify dedication/non-sharing/least privilege and the absence of human use of these accounts.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Inventory of technical accounts with owner, scope, and privileges.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = dedicated accounts with minimal privileges ; partial = dedicated but over-privileged accounts ; non-compliant = shared accounts
actions_audit: List the technical accounts and cross-check against the usage logs.
Verify the granted privileges against the actual need.
If gap: create dedicated accounts and reduce the privileges.

constraints.regle: External access (partners, service providers) goes through invited federated identities; no local account outside the procedure.
constraints.verification: Inventory the active external accesses; verify their federation and the existence of a creation/revocation procedure.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Inventory of external identities + associated management procedure.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% federated with a procedure ; partial = federated without a revocation procedure ; non-compliant = external local accounts
actions_audit: Extract the list of external identities and their creation method.
Verify the revocation procedure (service provider's departure).
If gap: migrate to the profile's invited identity federation.

constraints.regle: Sensitive operations (authentication, elevation, access to protected data) are logged in a tamper-proof, timestamped manner.
constraints.verification: Verify the presence of the sensitive events in the logs, their timestamping, and the write protection (immutability/retention).
constraints.preuve_attendue: Log excerpts of the sensitive operations + immutability configuration.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = events complete, timestamped, protected ; partial = logged without protection ; non-compliant = sensitive operations not logged
actions_audit: Replay a sensitive operation in a test environment and find its trace.
Verify the retention/immutability policy of the audit logs.
If gap: instrument the missing events and protect the storage.

constraints.regle: Public clients (browser application, mobile) carry no static secret; authentication relies on short-lived tokens obtained via a flow adapted to public clients (PKCE or server-side intermediary).
constraints.verification: Inspect the delivered client artifacts (bundle, application) for embedded keys/secrets; verify the authentication flow used and the token lifetime.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Analysis of the client artifact (0 secrets) + description of the observed authentication flow.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = 0 embedded secrets + compliant public client flow ; partial = compliant flow but long-lived tokens ; non-compliant = static secret embedded client-side
actions_audit: Analyze the delivered bundle/application for secrets (scan + inspection); attach the report.
Document the public client's actual authentication flow; attach the capture.
If gap: remove the secret, revoke it, switch to a short-lived token flow (PKCE/server-side intermediary).

constraints.regle: Each personal data processing activity is recorded in the register of processing activities, with its purpose, its identified legal basis, and its categories of data and data subjects.
constraints.verification: Review the register of processing activities; verify its completeness against the processing actually carried out by the application and the presence of a legal basis for each processing activity.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Excerpt from the register of processing activities covering the application + justification of the legal basis adopted for each processing activity.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = all processing activities recorded with an identified legal basis ; partial = incomplete register or unjustified legal basis ; non-compliant = no register
actions_audit: Identify the data processing activities actually carried out by the application and compare them against the register.
Verify the legal basis adopted for each processing activity and its documented justification.
If gap: complete the register and have the missing legal basis decided by the compliance officer.
standards: RGPD — art. 30 (registre des activités de traitement)

constraints.regle: A data protection impact assessment (DPIA) is carried out, documented, and validated by the delegate/compliance officer whenever a processing activity presents a high risk to individuals; it is renewed with every substantial change to the processing.
constraints.verification: Determine whether the high-risk criteria are met (nature of the data, scale, cross-referencing, automated decision-making); if so, verify the existence, content, and validation of the DPIA.
constraints.preuve_attendue: DPIA signed/validated by the compliance officer, or documented analysis concluding there is no obligation.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = required DPIA carried out and validated, or absence of obligation demonstrated ; partial = DPIA started but not validated ; non-compliant = DPIA required and missing
actions_audit: Assess the criteria triggering the DPIA obligation with regard to the actual processing.
If required, verify the existence, content, and formal validation of the DPIA by the compliance officer.
If gap: initiate or finalize the DPIA before any broader release.
standards: RGPD — art. 35 (analyse d'impact relative à la protection des données)
RGPD — art. 36 (consultation préalable de l'autorité de contrôle)

constraints.regle: The AI system is classified according to the risk grid of the applicable jurisdiction pack (EU by default: AI Act — unacceptable / high / limited / minimal risk), and the obligations corresponding to the level adopted are formally tracked.
constraints.verification: Identify the system's functions that may fall under a risk category of the applicable jurisdiction pack; verify the classification adopted and its documented justification.
constraints.preuve_attendue: AI system classification sheet (category adopted, justification, identified applicable obligations).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = classification documented and justified, obligations tracked ; partial = classification sketched without a complete justification ; non-compliant = AI system not classified
actions_audit: Analyze the system's functions with regard to the classification grid of the applicable jurisdiction pack.
Verify the documented justification of the category adopted and the resulting obligations.
If gap: produce the classification and initiate compliance with the obligations of the identified level.
standards: AI Act — art. 6 et Annexe III (règles de classification)
AI Act — art. 9 (système de gestion des risques)

constraints.regle: Individuals interacting with the system are informed, in a clear, prior, and accessible manner, of the nature of the processing and, where applicable, of the automated or AI-generated character of the interaction or content.
constraints.verification: Walk through the user interaction point; verify the presence, clarity, and accessibility of the information on the processing and on the use of AI.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Capture of the user journey showing the information/transparency notice.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = clear and systematic information provided before interaction ; partial = information present but incomplete or hardly visible ; non-compliant = no information
actions_audit: Walk through the user interaction point and note the presence of the information notice.
Verify the clarity and accessibility of the notice (understandable language, visibility).
If gap: add or strengthen the information/transparency notice.

constraints.regle: Only the data strictly necessary for the declared purpose is collected, transmitted, and retained; any additional field, source, or use is explicitly justified.
constraints.verification: Compare the data actually collected/transmitted against the strict need of the declared purpose; identify any unjustified excess field.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Map of the data collected with the associated purpose per field.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = data strictly necessary, deviations justified ; partial = a few unjustified excess fields ; non-compliant = widespread disproportionate collection
actions_audit: Map the data collected/transmitted and its declared purpose.
Identify the excess fields relative to the strict need.
If gap: remove or formally justify each excess field.

constraints.regle: The rights of data subjects (access, rectification, erasure, objection, portability) are supported by a procedure that is executable within the legal timeframes, tracked, and not dependent on ad hoc manual processing.
constraints.verification: Trigger or simulate a rights request; verify the processing timeframe, traceability, and completeness of the response provided.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Documented procedure for exercising rights + trace of a request processed within the timeframe.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = procedure supported and legal timeframe met, tracked ; partial = procedure exists but timeframe or traceability insufficient ; non-compliant = rights not supported
actions_audit: Verify the existence of a documented procedure for each data subject right.
Simulate a rights request and measure the processing timeframe and completeness.
If gap: build the missing procedure and train the relevant teams.
standards: RGPD — art. 15 à 22 (droits des personnes concernées)

constraints.regle: Any transfer of personal data outside the originating jurisdictional perimeter relies on a regulated mechanism (adequacy decision, standard contractual clauses, appropriate safeguards) documented flow by flow.
constraints.verification: Map the data flows leaving the originating jurisdictional perimeter; verify for each the applicable regulating mechanism and its documentation.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Map of cross-border flows + regulating mechanism documented per flow (clauses, adequacy decision, safeguards).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = all out-of-jurisdiction flows regulated and documented ; partial = flows partially regulated or incomplete documentation ; non-compliant = out-of-jurisdiction transfer with no regulating mechanism
actions_audit: Map the data flows leaving the originating jurisdictional perimeter.
Verify the regulating mechanism applicable to each identified flow and its documentation.
If gap: implement the required regulating mechanism or suspend the uncovered flow.
standards: RGPD — art. 44 à 49 (transferts vers des pays tiers)

constraints.regle: Each data category is associated with a defined and proportionate retention period, with an effective purge (automated or procedural) at expiry.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a retention policy per data category and test the effective execution of the purge at the declared expiry.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Retention policy per data category + proof of purge execution (log, job report).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = periods defined and purge verified for all categories ; partial = periods defined without a verified purge ; non-compliant = periods not defined or data retained indefinitely
actions_audit: Verify the declared retention policy for each data category.
Check the effective execution of the purge at expiry on a data sample.
If gap: define the missing periods and instrument the automated purge.

constraints.regle: A data protection officer or a compliance officer is formally designated, reachable by data subjects and by project teams, and systematically consulted on high-risk processing activities.
constraints.verification: Verify the formal designation of the officer (appointment, published contact details) and their actual consultation on the project's high-risk processing activities.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Designation record for the officer + trace of consultation on at least one high-risk processing activity of the project.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = officer designated, reachable, and consulted on high-risk processing ; partial = officer designated but not systematically consulted ; non-compliant = no officer identified
actions_audit: Verify the existence and publication of the compliance officer's designation.
Verify the trace of the officer's consultation on the project's high-risk processing activities.
If gap: designate the missing officer and establish their systematic consultation.
standards: RGPD — art. 37 à 39 (délégué à la protection des données)

constraints.regle: The AI system has technical documentation covering the model (architecture, known limitations, performance metrics) and the training/validation data (origin, representativeness, governance).
constraints.verification: Request the technical documentation of the model and of the training/validation data; verify its completeness and its consistency with the actually deployed system.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Technical documentation of the model + governance sheet for the training/validation data.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = documentation complete and up to date, covering model and data ; partial = partial documentation (model or data only) ; non-compliant = no documentation
actions_audit: Request the technical documentation of the model and of the training/validation data.
Verify its consistency with the version of the system actually deployed.
If gap: produce or complete the missing documentation before any move to production.
standards: AI Act — art. 11 et Annexe IV (documentation technique)
ISO/IEC 42001:2023 — 8.3 (gestion du cycle de vie des systèmes d'IA)

constraints.regle: When an AI system falls under an active AI regulatory framework, the deployer's obligations are addressed before going into service: fundamental rights impact assessment where required, information for exposed individuals, designated and logged human oversight.
constraints.verification: Verify the regulatory qualification of the AI system, the existence of the impact assessment where required, the information notices to individuals, and the actual designation of human oversight.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Documented qualification + impact assessment (if required) + information notices + dated oversight designation.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = obligations addressed and tracked ; partial = qualification done, obligations incomplete ; non-compliant = system deployed without the obligations having been addressed
actions_audit: Qualify the system with regard to the active AI framework; attach the qualification.
Collect the impact assessment, information notices, and oversight designation; attach the proofs.
If gap: address the missing obligations before going into service.

constraints.regle: A data breach notification procedure is defined and tested: breach qualification, notification to the authority within the regulatory timeframe, information to individuals where required, and a breach register maintained.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of the procedure, the trace of an exercise (real or simulated), and the maintenance of the breach register.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Dated procedure + exercise report + excerpt from the breach register.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = procedure tested + register maintained ; partial = procedure defined but not tested ; non-compliant = no procedure
actions_audit: Request the notification procedure and its last exercise date; attach.
Verify the breach register (even if empty, it must exist); attach the excerpt.
If gap: establish the procedure, designate the responsible parties, schedule an exercise.

constraints.regle: Each data source and each data pipeline is inventoried and attached to a named business owner (Data Owner), responsible for arbitrating access, quality, and the asset's lifecycle.
constraints.verification: Extract the register of data sources and pipelines consumed or produced by the application; verify that each entry carries a named Data Owner and a last review date, and cross-check against the connections actually configured.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Register of sources/pipelines with a named Data Owner per entry and last review date + excerpt of the actual connection configuration.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% of sources/pipelines inventoried with a named Data Owner and review ≤ 12 months ; partial = partial coverage or expired review ; non-compliant = no register or a source with no identified Data Owner
actions_audit: Extract the list of data sources and pipelines connected to the application; cross-check against the declared register.
Verify for each entry the presence of a named Data Owner and the last review date.
If gap: complete the register and designate a Data Owner for each uncovered source or pipeline.

constraints.regle: Data assets (sources, tables, flows, datasets) follow a single, documented naming convention, whose compliance is verified by an automated check or by a tracked periodic review.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a documented and versioned naming convention for data assets, and the actual execution of a compliance check (automated in continuous integration or via periodic review).
constraints.preuve_attendue: Documented and versioned naming convention + latest compliance check report on asset names.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = convention documented and check active and tracked ; partial = convention documented but no check executed ; non-compliant = no formalized convention
actions_audit: Request the documented naming convention and its last revision date.
Review or run the latest compliance check report on existing asset names.
If gap: formalize the convention and schedule the automated check or the periodic review.

constraints.regle: For each critical reference dataset (reference entity shared across domains), an authoritative source (golden source) is declared and documented; no undeclared competing source is tolerated.
constraints.verification: Identify the critical reference datasets shared across domains; verify that a golden source is declared for each and look for the existence of undeclared competing sources.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Register of critical reference datasets with associated golden source + result of the competing-source detection review.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = golden source declared for all critical reference datasets and no undeclared competing source ; partial = golden source declared with documented exceptions ; non-compliant = critical reference dataset with no golden source
actions_audit: List the reference entities shared across several domains or teams.
Verify the declaration of a golden source per entity and look for undeclared replications.
If gap: arbitrate and declare the golden source, plan the switchover of consumers.
standards: ISO 8000-110 — qualité syntaxique et sémantique des données maîtres

constraints.regle: The quality of each critical data asset (completeness, uniqueness, format, freshness, statistical drift) is continuously measured by automated declarative rules, against explicitly documented thresholds.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a catalog of quality rules with thresholds per critical asset, the automated execution of these rules at each cycle, and the trace of the alerts or blocks triggered upon a threshold breach, including statistical drift relative to a reference distribution.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Catalog of quality rules with thresholds + history of executions and triggered alerts, including drift indicators.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = automated rules active on all critical assets, thresholds documented, drift monitored ; partial = rules defined but execution manual, partial, or drift not monitored ; non-compliant = no formalized rules
actions_audit: Extract the catalog of declared quality rules and their thresholds per critical asset.
Verify the execution history and the alerts/blocks actually triggered, including for statistical drift.
If gap: define the missing rules and thresholds and automate their execution.
standards: ISO/IEC 25012:2008 — modèle de qualité des données
ISO/IEC 25024:2015 — mesures de qualité des données

constraints.regle: Data processing pipelines are structured into progressive refinement layers (raw → cleansed/conformed → consumable), documented, replayable idempotently, and governed by contracts between layers.
constraints.verification: Verify the architecture diagram of the processing layers, the documented input/output contract of each layer, and the ability to replay a process from an intermediate state without side effects (idempotence).
constraints.preuve_attendue: Pipeline layer diagram + documented contracts between layers + proof of idempotent replay (log or test).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = layers documented, governed by contracts, idempotent replay proven ; partial = layers present without a formalized contract or replay not proven ; non-compliant = opaque single-step transformation, not traceable
actions_audit: Obtain the architecture diagram of the data processing layers and the associated contracts.
Replay a process on a sample from an intermediate state and verify the absence of side effects (idempotence).
If gap: document the missing layer contracts and fix the non-idempotent processes.

constraints.regle: Every data exchange between a producer and its consumers (file, flow, API, shared table) is governed by a versioned data contract, verified before each publication of a structural change.
constraints.verification: Identify the data exchanges between teams or systems; verify the existence of a versioned contract for each and the execution of a compatibility check before publishing a change.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Register of data contracts with version history + compatibility check report for the last published change.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = versioned contract and automated verification active for all critical exchanges ; partial = contract documented without automated verification ; non-compliant = no formalized contract
actions_audit: Map the data exchanges between the producer and its consumers.
Verify the version of the contract in force and the compatibility report of the last change.
If gap: formalize the contract and hook up the compatibility check before publication.

constraints.regle: The end-to-end lineage of each critical data asset (from the source to final consumption) is automatically tracked and viewable, to allow tracing any inconsistent result back to its cause.
constraints.verification: Select a critical data asset and verify that its complete lineage graph (sources, transformations, consumers) is viewable and up to date.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Capture of the lineage graph of a critical asset, from the source to consumption.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = end-to-end lineage viewable for all critical assets ; partial = partial lineage (missing segments) ; non-compliant = no traceable lineage
actions_audit: Choose a critical asset and request the rendering of its complete lineage graph.
Verify the freshness and completeness of the lineage (no missing segment between source and consumption).
If gap: instrument the lineage on the missing segments.
standards: ISO 8000-8 — qualité de l'information : concepts et mesure

constraints.regle: Each critical data asset carries a declared retention policy (duration, archiving, purge), applied and verified, independent of the storage medium.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a declared retention policy per critical asset and the actual execution of the scheduled purges/archiving.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Register of retention policies per asset + execution report of the scheduled purges/archiving.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = policy declared and purge/archiving executed for all relevant assets ; partial = policy declared without verifiable execution ; non-compliant = no policy
actions_audit: Extract the register of declared retention policies per critical asset.
Verify the latest execution report of the scheduled purges/archiving.
If gap: declare the missing policy and schedule its automation.

constraints.regle: Each critical data asset is backed up in accordance with an explicitly declared recovery point objective (RPO), and restoration is tested periodically.
constraints.verification: Verify the RPO declared per critical asset, the compliance of the actual backups with that objective, and the existence of a recent restoration exercise.
constraints.preuve_attendue: RPO declared per asset + report of the latest restoration exercise (duration, integrity observed).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = RPO declared and met, restoration successfully tested ≤ 12 months ago ; partial = RPO declared without a recent test ; non-compliant = no RPO declared or last test failed and uncorrected
actions_audit: Extract the declared RPO and the actual backup frequency per critical asset.
Verify the date and the result of the latest restoration exercise.
If gap: declare the missing RPO, correct the backup frequency, and schedule a restoration test.

constraints.regle: The reporting semantic model is documented and validated by a modeling authority before exposure; each measure is defined only once.
constraints.verification: Request the documentation of the semantic model (entities, measures, dimensions) and the trace of validation; look for measures defined twice across reports.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Model documentation + validation report + inventory of measures.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = model documented, validated, measures unique ; partial = model documented but not validated ; non-compliant = model not documented or duplicated measures
actions_audit: Collect the semantic model documentation; attach the excerpt.
Cross-check the measure definitions across exposed reports; list the duplicates.
If gap: centralize the definition of measures and have the model validated.

constraints.regle: The reporting layer draws exclusively from a governed and recorded source of truth; no unrecorded parallel extraction feeds an exposed report.
constraints.verification: Inventory the connections of the exposed reports; compare against the list of governed sources; look for unrecorded local extractions and copies.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Inventory of the reporting layer's connections with governed/unrecorded status.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% of connections to governed sources ; partial = recorded parallel extractions being phased out ; non-compliant = active unrecorded feeds
actions_audit: Extract the connections/feeds of the exposed reports; attach the inventory.
Cross-check against the register of governed sources; list the deviations.
If gap: reconnect the report to the governed source and close the parallel extraction.

constraints.regle: Significant transformation logic is tested and versioned as close to the source as possible; it is not recreated in the reporting tool.
constraints.verification: Examine where the transformations live (versioned pipelines vs. formulas embedded in reports); assess the share of business logic carried by the reporting layer.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Inventory of transformations with location + excerpts (versioned pipeline vs. report).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = significant logic versioned close to the source ; partial = residual logic in reporting, documented ; non-compliant = major business logic recreated in the reports
actions_audit: List the significant transformations and their location; attach the inventory.
Verify the tests and versioning of the transformations on the source side.
If gap: push the logic back down to the prepared layer and simplify the reports.

constraints.regle: A shared, standardized time dimension (civil calendar, fiscal year) is referenced by every exposed semantic model — no locally recalculated calendar.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a central time dimension and its actual referencing by the exposed models; look for diverging local calendars.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Definition of the time dimension + list of the models referencing it.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = single dimension referenced everywhere ; partial = dimension exists but not generalized ; non-compliant = diverging local calendars
actions_audit: Identify the reference time dimension; attach its definition.
Verify its use in each exposed model; list the local calendars.
If gap: substitute the shared dimension for the local calendars.

constraints.regle: The storage/connection mode of each exposed report is chosen and documented according to a declared need profile (freshness, volume, load on the source) — no implicit default choice.
constraints.verification: Request the documented choice rule and verify, on a sample of reports, the consistency between the declared need profile and the observed mode.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Choice rule + sample of reports with the observed mode and declared need.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = rule documented and applied ; partial = rule documented but not applied systematically ; non-compliant = unjustified inconsistent choices
actions_audit: Collect the access mode choice rule; attach the document.
Sample 5 reports and compare the observed mode vs. the declared need.
If gap: document the rule and realign the out-of-profile reports.

constraints.regle: Each published report carries a governance status visible to the end user (certified / exploratory / deprecated), assigned and reviewed by a named authority.
constraints.verification: Inventory the published reports and their displayed status; verify the existence of the certification authority and the trace of the reviews.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Inventory of reports with status + certification review report.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% of reports statused and reviewed ; partial = statuses present without periodic review ; non-compliant = reports published with no status
actions_audit: Extract the list of published reports and their visible status; attach the inventory.
Verify the certification authority and the latest review; attach the report.
If gap: establish the visible status and the periodic review by the authority.

constraints.regle: Data residency (location) is declared by classification, applied by design, and verifiable for each category subject to a location requirement.
constraints.verification: Verify the residency declaration per data classification and its correspondence with the actual location of storage and processing.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Classification → declared residency table + proof of the actual location of storage.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = residency declared and verified ; partial = declared but not verified ; non-compliant = no residency declaration
actions_audit: Collect the classification → residency table; attach.
Verify the actual location of a sample of storage; attach the captures.
If gap: declare the residency per classification and correct the out-of-zone storage.

constraints.regle: Asynchronous integrations (message queues, event notifications, deferred tasks) are designed to be received multiple times without duplicate effects (idempotence), with a bounded retry policy and a dead-letter queue dedicated to repeated failures.
constraints.verification: Verify the presence of a unique message identifier guaranteeing deduplication, the configuration of a bounded retry policy (delay, maximum number of attempts), and the activation of a dead-letter queue for repeatedly failing messages.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Retry policy configuration (delay, max attempts) + dead-letter queue configuration + example of a message replay without duplicate effect.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = idempotence demonstrated + bounded retry + active dead-letter queue ; partial = idempotence demonstrated without a dead-letter queue ; non-compliant = no idempotence guarantee observed
actions_audit: Verify the presence of a unique message identifier and the deduplication mechanism for each asynchronous integration; attach the configuration excerpts.
Replay a duplicate message in a test environment and confirm the absence of a duplicated business effect; document the result.
If a gap is found: design the missing idempotence and activate a bounded dead-letter queue.
standards: EIP — Enterprise Integration Patterns (Idempotent Receiver, Dead Letter Channel)

constraints.regle: Consumed external dependencies (third-party APIs, AI inference models, shared services) are subject to known, documented, and monitored quotas and rate thresholds, with a controlled degradation plan in case of overrun.
constraints.verification: Inventory the consumed external dependencies and their contractual quotas (TPM/RPM, calls/minute); verify that observed usage stays under the declared thresholds and that a degradation plan (queueing, fallback, controlled error message) exists in case of overrun.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Inventory of external dependencies with contractual quotas + observed usage over the period + documented degradation plan.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = quotas known, usage under threshold, degradation plan tested ; partial = quotas known without a degradation plan ; non-compliant = quotas unknown or overruns not controlled
actions_audit: Inventory the consumed external dependencies and their contractual quotas; attach the inventory and observed usage.
Simulate or observe a quota overrun and verify the degradation behavior; document the result.
If a gap is found: negotiate/document the missing quotas and implement a degradation plan.
standards: Site Reliability Engineering (Google) — gestion de la charge

constraints.regle: Latency targets (p50/p95/p99) are declared for each critical journey and continuously measured under real conditions, with systematic comparison to the declared target.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of declared latency targets per critical journey and the presence of p50/p95/p99 metrics measured over a representative period (7-30 days); compare the measurements to the declared targets.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Document of latency targets per journey + export of p50/p95/p99 metrics measured over the period.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = targets declared and measurements compliant over the period ; partial = measurements available without a declared target (or vice versa) ; non-compliant = neither target nor measurement available
actions_audit: Extract the p50/p95/p99 latency metrics over a representative period for each critical journey; attach the export.
Compare the measurements to the declared targets; document any observed gaps.
If a gap is found: declare the missing targets or instrument the unmeasured journeys.

constraints.regle: Load tests representative of the target are run regularly, at minimum before every major production release, with performance budgets defined and verified in continuous integration, blocking any significant regression.
constraints.verification: Look for the load test scripts (k6, Locust, JMeter, or equivalent) and their execution in CI; verify the existence of performance thresholds (budgets) and the pipeline's behavior in case of overrun.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Report of the latest load test + performance budget configuration in CI + evidence of a pipeline failure on budget overrun.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = regular load tests + active blocking budgets ; partial = regular load tests without a blocking budget ; non-compliant = no load test observed
actions_audit: Look for the load test scripts and execution history; attach the latest report.
Verify the performance budget configuration in CI and trigger a regression test to confirm the blocking behavior; document the result.
If a gap is found: implement the missing load tests and blocking budgets.
standards: ISO/IEC 25010:2011 — Efficacité de performance (utilisation des ressources)
DORA (Accelerate) — pratiques de test en continu

constraints.regle: A caching strategy is defined and applied to the identified contention points (costly responses, recurring calls to external dependencies), with an explicit invalidation policy.
constraints.verification: Identify the contention points (latency, cost, load) on the main journeys and verify the presence of a suitable caching mechanism (application, HTTP, semantic) with a documented invalidation policy.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Cache configuration (TTL, key, scope) + justification of the contention points covered.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = cache in place on the major contention points with controlled invalidation ; partial = partial cache or uncontrolled invalidation ; non-compliant = no cache despite identified contention points
actions_audit: Identify the contention points (latency, cost, load) on the main journeys; attach the analysis.
Verify the cache configuration and its invalidation policy at these points; document the coverage.
If a gap is found: implement the missing cache and define the invalidation policy.
standards: ISO/IEC 25010:2011 — Efficacité de performance (utilisation des ressources)

constraints.regle: Every endpoint returning a collection applies systematic pagination with a bounded page size, avoiding any uncontrolled payload.
constraints.verification: Inventory the endpoints returning collections; verify the presence of pagination (cursor or offset/limit) and a bounded maximum page size for each.
