constraints.preuve_attendue: List of collection endpoints with pagination parameters + example of a full, non-paginated payload response (if applicable).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = systematic and bounded pagination on 100% of collection endpoints ; partial = partial pagination ; non-compliant = endpoints returning unbounded collections
actions_audit: Inventory the endpoints returning collections; attach the list with pagination parameters.
Query an endpoint without a pagination parameter and confirm the presence of a default bound; document the result.
If a gap is found: instrument the missing pagination and bound the page size.

constraints.regle: Connections to stateful dependent services (database, cache, third-party services) are managed by a properly sized and configured connection pool, avoiding any connection exhaustion under load.
constraints.verification: Verify the connection pooling configuration (min/max size, timeout) for each stateful dependency, and the absence of a connection opened per request.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Connection pool configuration per dependency + pool usage metrics under load.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = pooling configured and sized for all stateful dependencies ; partial = partial pooling ; non-compliant = non-pooled connections (opened per request)
actions_audit: Inventory the stateful dependencies (database, cache, third-party services) and their pooling configuration; attach the inventory.
Observe the pool usage metrics under load (saturation, wait time); document the result.
If a gap is found: configure the missing pooling and size it according to the target load.
standards: ISO/IEC 25010:2011 — Efficacité de performance (utilisation des ressources)

constraints.regle: The horizontal and/or vertical scaling capacity is documented (chosen mechanism, known limits) and validated by a test representative of the target load.
constraints.verification: Verify the documentation of the scalability mechanism (horizontal autoscaling, vertical scale-up) and the existence of a test that validated the declared target load.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Scalability strategy documentation + target load test report + autoscaling configuration.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = scalability documented and validated by a test at target ; partial = documented without test validation ; non-compliant = scalability not documented
actions_audit: Request the documentation of the scalability mechanism (horizontal/vertical) and its known limits; attach the document.
Verify the load test report that validated the declared target; document the result.
If a gap is found: document the mechanism and conduct the missing target validation test.

constraints.regle: A minimal tag taxonomy (application, environment, domain, owner) is defined, published, and applied from the creation of any billable resource.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a published tag taxonomy (mandatory keys) and the application of a creation-time control (policy) preventing the provisioning of non-compliant resources.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Reference to the published tag taxonomy + configuration of the creation-time control policy.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = taxonomy published + active blocking control at creation ; partial = taxonomy published without automated control ; non-compliant = absence of taxonomy observed
actions_audit: Request the published tag taxonomy (mandatory keys); attach the reference.
Provision a non-compliant test resource and verify the blocking by the policy; document the result.
If a gap is found: publish the taxonomy and activate the blocking control at creation.

constraints.regle: The tagging compliance rate of the resource portfolio is measured periodically, with an automatic alert on any non-compliant resource detected.
constraints.verification: Run or review the latest tagging compliance report; verify the compliance rate obtained and the presence of an active alert on non-compliant resources.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Dated tagging compliance report with measured rate and list of non-compliant resources.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = ≥ 98% compliance and active alert ; partial = measurement available without automated alert ; non-compliant = no compliance measurement available
actions_audit: Extract the latest tagging compliance report for the portfolio; attach the observed rate.
Verify the alert configuration for non-compliant resources; document its activation.
If a gap is found: implement the missing periodic measurement and alert.

constraints.regle: Every billable resource carries an application tag unambiguously resolved in the service registry, enabling cost tracking by application and by business unit without manual reconstruction.
constraints.verification: Verify that all resources carry a valid application tag resolved in the service registry (CMDB) and that cost can be broken down by application/business unit without manual investigation.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Application tag ↔ service registry reconciliation report + example of cost breakdown by application.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% resolution and automated breakdown by business unit ; partial = documented manual resolution for gaps ; non-compliant = orphaned resources not detected
actions_audit: Extract the reconciliation report between application tags and the service registry; attach the resolution rate.
Simulate resolving an incident from an isolated resource to the owning application; time and document it.
If a gap is found: fix the orphaned resources and automate the periodic reconciliation.

constraints.regle: A budget is declared for each significant scope (application, environment), with an automatic drift alert at progressive thresholds (e.g., 50%/80%/100%).
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a declared budget for each significant scope and the effective configuration of drift alerts at multiple progressive thresholds.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Budget and alert configuration + alert trigger history.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = budget covering all significant scopes + active multi-threshold alerts ; partial = partial budget or single-threshold alert ; non-compliant = absence of a declared budget
actions_audit: Inventory the budgets declared per significant scope; attach the configuration.
Verify the effective triggering of alerts at progressive thresholds (history); document the result.
If a gap is found: declare the missing budgets and configure the multi-threshold alerts.

constraints.regle: A periodic FinOps review is held, with a dated report and recorded arbitration decisions.
constraints.verification: Request the reports of the latest FinOps reviews; verify their regularity and the presence of recorded decisions, beyond a simple dashboard review.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Dated report of the latest FinOps review + recurring review schedule.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = regular review tracked with recorded decisions ; partial = irregular review or without recorded decisions ; non-compliant = no FinOps review observed
actions_audit: Request the reports of the latest FinOps reviews and their schedule; attach the documents.
Verify the presence of recorded arbitration decisions in the reports; document the finding.
If a gap is found: establish the missing review cadence and decision-report format.

constraints.regle: The current operating cost is known, broken down by resource and by service, and a cost projection at target scale (volume, users) is documented with explicit calculation assumptions.
constraints.verification: Verify the export of costs for the last 30-90 days broken down by resource/service and the existence of a quantified projection at target with explicit assumptions (users, requests/day, volume).
constraints.preuve_attendue: Broken-down cost export + target projection document with calculation assumptions.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = cost known and broken down + documented quantified projection ; partial = cost known without projection (or projection without breakdown) ; non-compliant = cost not measured
actions_audit: Extract the cost export for the last 30-90 days broken down by resource/service; attach the export.
Request the target projection document and verify that the calculation assumptions are made explicit; document the finding.
If a gap is found: produce the missing breakdown and/or projection.

constraints.regle: Relevant cost optimizations are identified, quantified, and prioritized in an action plan: routing to a cost-effective model based on complexity, semantic caching, and context compression for AI inference costs; sizing, reservation, or scheduled shutdown for other resources.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a quantified optimization plan (estimated gain, effort) covering both traditional infrastructure costs and, where applicable, AI inference costs (model routing, semantic caching, prompt compression).
constraints.preuve_attendue: Dated optimization plan with estimated gains and implementation status.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = quantified optimization plan partially implemented ; partial = optimizations identified but not quantified ; non-compliant = no optimization identified
actions_audit: Request the quantified cost optimization plan, including AI inference costs where applicable; attach the document.
Verify the implementation status of the priority optimizations (model routing, caching, compression); document the progress.
If a gap is found: identify and quantify the missing optimizations, then prioritize their implementation.

constraints.regle: Every code change, whether application code or infrastructure as code, is subject before merge to automated convention checks (lint, format, policy validation) and a review by at least one peer, in a blocking manner.
constraints.verification: Verify the configuration of the automated checks (linter, formatter, policy validation) triggered on every proposed change, as well as the requirement for a review approval before merge.
constraints.preuve_attendue: CI configuration of the linter/formatter/policy + branch protection configuration requiring an approved review.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = automated checks and review mandatory and blocking ; partial = only one of the two ; non-compliant = merge possible without check or review
actions_audit: Verify the linter/formatter/policy validation configuration triggered on every proposed change; attach the CI configuration.
Confirm from the pull request history the absence of merges without a review approval; document the result.
If a gap is found: activate the automated checks and the branch protection requiring review.

constraints.regle: The results of security scans (SAST, secrets, dependencies) run in continuous integration are tracked by version and integrated as a code quality criterion, on the same footing as test coverage and technical debt.
constraints.verification: Verify that scan results are retained by version (history) and reviewed or aggregated in the same dashboard or process as the other code quality indicators.
constraints.preuve_attendue: History of scan results by version + quality dashboard including the security indicator.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = results tracked by version and integrated into the quality dashboard ; partial = results tracked without integration into quality tracking ; non-compliant = results not retained
actions_audit: Verify the historical retention of scan results by version; attach the excerpt.
Confirm the integration of the security indicator into the code quality dashboard or process; document the result.
If a gap is found: instrument the missing retention and integration.

constraints.regle: Unit test coverage is measured at every integration, with a minimum threshold defined and verified automatically.
constraints.verification: Run or review the latest coverage report; verify the presence of a configured minimum threshold and the pipeline's behavior when coverage falls below the threshold.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Coverage report by module + minimum threshold configuration in CI + evidence of a pipeline failure below the threshold.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = coverage measured, threshold defined and blocking ; partial = coverage measured without a blocking threshold ; non-compliant = coverage not measured
actions_audit: Extract the latest test coverage report by module; attach the report.
Verify the minimum threshold configuration in CI and trigger a regression test to confirm the blocking behavior; document the result.
If a gap is found: define the threshold and activate the missing blocking behavior.

constraints.regle: Critical functional journeys are covered by automated integration (or end-to-end) tests, run on every change.
constraints.verification: Identify the critical journeys (declared in D00) and verify the existence of integration/e2e tests covering them, run automatically on every change.
constraints.preuve_attendue: List of critical journeys with associated test + integration test execution report.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = all critical journeys covered and run automatically ; partial = partial coverage of critical journeys ; non-compliant = no integration test observed
actions_audit: Identify the critical functional journeys and look for the corresponding integration/e2e tests; attach the mapping.
Verify the automatic execution of these tests on every change; document the result.
If a gap is found: develop the missing integration tests for the uncovered journeys.

constraints.regle: Cyclomatic complexity and technical debt (TODO/FIXME, excessively long functions) are measured periodically and tracked over time, with a documented alert threshold.
constraints.verification: Run or review the complexity analysis tool (radon, ESLint complexity, or equivalent); verify the tracking over time and the existence of a documented alert threshold.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Dated complexity report + trend history + documented alert threshold.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = periodic measurement tracked over time with an alert threshold ; partial = one-off measurement without trend tracking ; non-compliant = complexity/debt not measured
actions_audit: Run or review the complexity and technical debt analysis tool; attach the dated report.
Verify the trend tracking over time and the existence of a documented alert threshold; document the finding.
If a gap is found: tool the missing periodic measurement and define the alert threshold.

constraints.regle: The entire test suite (unit and integration) is run automatically on every proposed change, with a pipeline that blocks on any failure.
constraints.verification: Verify the CI pipeline configuration triggering the test suite on every change and the effective blocking of the merge or deployment in case of failure.
constraints.preuve_attendue: CI pipeline configuration + evidence of a recent block due to test failure.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = full suite run and 100% blocking ; partial = run without systematic blocking ; non-compliant = tests not run in CI
actions_audit: Verify the pipeline configuration triggering the full test suite on every change; attach the configuration.
Trigger a deliberate test failure in a test environment and confirm the pipeline blocks; document the result.
If a gap is found: fix the configuration to make the pipeline block on failure.

constraints.regle: Every deployment to a managed environment passes exclusively through an automated CI/CD pipeline; each run produces an immutable, timestamped log (author, version, target, result).
constraints.verification: Inventory the direct deployment access (outside the pipeline) on each managed environment; verify that no recent deployment bypasses the pipeline, and that the execution log is immutable and complete (author, version, target, result).
constraints.preuve_attendue: Inventory of deployment access by environment + excerpt of the pipeline execution log over the audit period.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = 0 deployment outside the pipeline observed + complete immutable log ; partial = documented and waived exceptions ; non-compliant = untracked manual deployment observed
actions_audit: Inspect the direct deployment access on each managed environment; attach the access inventory.
Confirm from the pipeline execution log the absence of deployments outside the pipeline over the audit period; document the result.
If a gap is found: revoke the direct deployment access and route every deployment through the pipeline.

constraints.regle: All managed infrastructure is described as code (Infrastructure as Code), whose reference state is stored remotely, versioned, and locked, with no out-of-band modification.
constraints.verification: Verify the IaC coverage of the managed infrastructure (absence of resources created outside the code), the remote state configuration (locking, versioning), and the execution of drift detection.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Remote state configuration + drift detection report + inventory of resources not covered by IaC (if applicable).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = 0 drift detected + remote state locked and versioned ; partial = isolated drift corrected ; non-compliant = undetected or recurring out-of-band modification
actions_audit: Run or review the latest drift detection report between the declared state and the actual state; attach the report.
Verify the remote state configuration (locking, versioning); document the finding.
If a gap is found: cover the missing resources with IaC and secure the remote state.
standards: CIS Controls v8 — 4 (configuration sécurisée par policy-as-code)

constraints.regle: SAST, secrets detection, and vulnerable dependency scans are integrated into the pipeline and run on every integration, as a blocking gate on any critical vulnerability.
constraints.verification: Verify the presence of the three scan types (SAST, secrets, dependencies) in the pipeline configuration and the pipeline's blocking behavior on critical detection.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Scan gate configuration in the pipeline + scan reports over recent history + evidence of a block on a critical vulnerability.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = 3 scans active and blocking on high criticality ; partial = scans active but not blocking ; non-compliant = absence of at least one scan type
actions_audit: Verify the configuration of the three scans (SAST, secrets, dependencies) in the pipeline; attach the configuration.
Introduce a canary vulnerability in a test environment and confirm the pipeline blocks; document the result.
If a gap is found: integrate the missing scans and activate the blocking behavior.

constraints.regle: A progressive deployment strategy (blue-green, canary, or rolling depending on context) is documented and applied, and the promotion of a version from one environment to the next passes exclusively through the pipeline, with a tracked approval at each stage.
constraints.verification: Verify the documentation of the chosen deployment strategy (blue-green/canary/rolling) and its effective application; verify that inter-environment promotion can only happen via the pipeline, with a trace of the approval at each stage passed.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Deployment strategy documentation + inter-environment promotion approval configuration + log of a recent promotion.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = progressive strategy documented and applied + promotion exclusively via pipeline with tracked approvals ; partial = strategy documented without tracked promotion (or vice versa) ; non-compliant = direct deployment without progressive strategy or traceability
actions_audit: Request the documentation of the chosen progressive deployment strategy; attach the document.
Verify the log of a recent promotion (gates passed, approver, timestamp); document the result.
If a gap is found: document the strategy and track the missing promotion approvals.
standards: DORA (Accelerate) — capacité de livraison continue (déploiement progressif)
SLSA — provenance et reproductibilité du build

constraints.regle: Every published artifact (library, service, image) applies a semantic versioning scheme (major.minor.patch), automatically verified in continuous integration, with release notes published for each version.
constraints.verification: Verify the configuration of the automatic version scheme check in CI and the systematic publication of release notes for each delivered version.
constraints.preuve_attendue: History of published versions + associated release notes + configuration of the automatic scheme verification.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = scheme respected and verified in CI + systematic notes ; partial = scheme respected without automated verification or without systematic notes ; non-compliant = versions not distinguishable or duplicated
actions_audit: Verify the configuration of the automatic version scheme check in CI; attach the configuration.
Confirm the publication of release notes for the latest delivered versions; document the result.
If a gap is found: instrument the automatic verification and systematize the missing release notes.

constraints.regle: The repository applies branch protection on the reference branch (prohibition of direct push, required verification statuses) and requires an approved peer review before any merge.
constraints.verification: Verify the reference branch protection configuration (merge rules, required statuses, prohibition of direct push) and the number of approvals required before merge.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Capture of the branch protection configuration + pull request history showing the absence of direct pushes to the protected branch.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = active protection + mandatory review + no direct push observed ; partial = active protection without mandatory review ; non-compliant = reference branch not protected
actions_audit: Verify the reference branch protection configuration (settings, required approvals); attach the capture.
Confirm from the history the absence of direct pushes to the protected branch; document the result.
If a gap is found: activate the missing branch protection and review requirement.
standards: CIS Controls v8 — 16 (sécurité du logiciel applicatif)

constraints.regle: A rollback strategy is defined, tooled by the pipeline, and tested periodically at a defined frequency, without direct manual intervention on the target.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a rollback mechanism triggerable from the pipeline and the trace of the last rollback exercise (date, result, measured restoration time).
constraints.preuve_attendue: Report of the latest rollback exercise + measured restoration time + configuration of the trigger from the pipeline.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = rollback tooled, exercised at the defined frequency, restoration time objective met ; partial = rollback exercised but objective exceeded or frequency not respected ; non-compliant = no rollback exercise observed
actions_audit: Request the report of the latest rollback exercise and the measured restoration time; attach the report.
Verify that triggering the rollback requires no direct manual intervention on the target; document the result.
If a gap is found: tool the rollback from the pipeline and schedule the missing periodic exercise.

constraints.regle: All application components emit structured logs (machine-parseable format, timestamp, component identifier) with standardized severity levels consistent across services (debug/info/warn/error/fatal).
constraints.verification: Verify that each component emits logs in a single structured format and that the severity scale used is identical from one service to another; check for the absence of unstructured free-text output in production.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Structured log excerpts from at least 3 distinct components + reference of the profile's standardized severity levels.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = structured format and severity scale consistent across all components ; partial = structured on the major components, inconsistent on secondary components ; non-compliant = unstructured free-text logs or inconsistent scale
actions_audit: Extract a log sample from each component and verify compliance with the declared structured format.
Compare the severity levels used across components and flag any scale inconsistency.
If a gap is found: prioritize migrating the remaining components to the structured format and common scale.

constraints.regle: Every incoming request is assigned a correlation identifier (or a distributed trace) propagated across all components and services traversed, enabling the complete reconstruction of a transaction's journey end to end.
constraints.verification: Replay a transaction on a critical journey traversing several components and verify that the correlation identifier or distributed trace allows the complete journey to be reconstructed, from the entry point to the final response.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Capture of an end-to-end trace (or chain of logs linked by a unique identifier) on at least one declared critical journey.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = complete and usable end-to-end trace on all declared critical journeys ; partial = correlation present but interrupted at some service hops ; non-compliant = no inter-service correlation
actions_audit: Identify the declared critical journeys and replay a transaction end to end.
Verify that the correlation identifier traverses each service hop without interruption.
If a gap is found: instrument the missing services and document the uncovered journeys.

constraints.regle: Each component continuously exposes its technical metrics (latency, error rate, throughput, resource saturation) to the profile's monitoring platform, with sufficient history for trend analysis.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence and freshness of the technical metrics by component (latency p50/p95/p99, error rate, throughput, saturation) and the depth of history available.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Capture of the technical metrics exposed by component over a representative period (≥ 30 days if available).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = complete and historized technical metrics on all critical components ; partial = partial metrics or insufficient history ; non-compliant = no technical metric exposed
actions_audit: Inventory the technical metrics exposed by component and their history depth.
Verify the coverage of the essential signals (latency, errors, throughput, saturation) on the critical components.
If a gap is found: instrument the missing components and set a minimum retention duration.
standards: Google SRE — signaux dorés (latence, trafic, erreurs, saturation)

constraints.regle: Significant business activity indicators (volumes processed, functional success rate, usage by feature) are instrumented and exposed on the same footing as technical metrics, with an identified business owner.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of instrumented business metrics, their alignment with the KPIs declared in the functional scope (D00), and the identification of a business owner.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Capture of the exposed business metrics + mapping to the functional scope's KPIs.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = business metrics instrumented, aligned with the KPIs, and tracked by an identified owner ; partial = metrics present but not linked to the KPIs or without an owner ; non-compliant = no business metric instrumented
actions_audit: Compare the instrumented business metrics against the list of KPIs declared in the functional scope.
Verify the identification of a business owner for tracking these indicators.
If a gap is found: instrument the missing KPIs and designate a tracking owner.

constraints.regle: Operational dashboards continuously consolidate the application's essential technical and business signals, viewable by the operations teams without needing to involve the development team.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of operational dashboards covering the essential technical and business signals, their accessibility to the operations teams, and their continuous refresh.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Captures of the operational dashboards in place + list of roles with access to them.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = dashboards covering technical and business signals, accessible to Run, continuously refreshed ; partial = technical dashboards only or access restricted to the development team ; non-compliant = no operational dashboard
actions_audit: List the existing operational dashboards and their coverage (technical, business).
Verify the effective access of the operations teams without dependency on the development team.
If a gap is found: complete the missing coverage and grant access to the relevant teams.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion des événements

constraints.regle: Alerts triggered on critical services are based on declared service level objectives (SLOs) and the associated error budget consumption, rather than on isolated technical thresholds disconnected from the service commitment.
constraints.verification: Verify the declaration of SLOs by critical service and the existence of alert rules based on the associated error budget consumption, rather than on raw technical thresholds.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Declaration of SLOs by critical service + configuration of the error budget alert rules + history of at least one triggered alert.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = SLOs declared and error budget alerting active for all critical services ; partial = SLOs declared without linked alerting ; non-compliant = technical thresholds only, no SLO declared
actions_audit: List the SLOs declared by critical service and verify their consistency with the actual service commitment.
Verify the configuration of the error budget consumption alert rules and test their triggering.
If a gap is found: declare the missing SLOs and connect the alerting to the corresponding error budget.
standards: SRE (Google) — objectifs de niveau de service et budgets d'erreur

constraints.regle: The error budget consumption of each critical service is tracked continuously and triggers a predefined action (change freeze, on-call mobilization) before it is fully exhausted.
constraints.verification: Verify the error budget consumption history of the critical services and the existence of a documented action triggered before exhaustion (e.g., deployment freeze).
constraints.preuve_attendue: Error budget consumption history + trace of at least one action triggered by a consumption threshold.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = budget tracked continuously and documented action triggered before exhaustion, with supporting evidence ; partial = budget tracked without a formalized action ; non-compliant = error budget not tracked
actions_audit: Extract the error budget consumption history for the last 90 days for each critical service.
Verify the existence and effective triggering of an action when a consumption threshold is crossed.
If a gap is found: define the action thresholds and link them to the on-call procedure (D12).

constraints.regle: A log retention policy, declared by category and aligned with the applicable legal or contractual obligation, governs purging and archiving; their execution is verifiable through dated evidence.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a retention policy declared by log category and the evidence of effective purge/archiving execution in accordance with the declared durations.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Retention policy documented by category + execution report of the latest purge/archiving.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = policy declared by category and purge verified compliant with the durations ; partial = policy declared without recent execution evidence ; non-compliant = indefinite retention or absence of policy
actions_audit: Request the retention policy by log category and verify its alignment with the applicable obligation.
Verify the trace of the latest purge/archiving execution and its compliance with the declared durations.
If a gap is found: formalize the missing policy and schedule the purge of the categories in overrun.

constraints.regle: No sensitive data in clear text (secret, token, password, identifying personal data) reaches the application logs or telemetry: redaction or masking is applied at the source or in the pipeline before any storage.
constraints.verification: Run a test transaction injecting known sensitive data (canary secret, test PII) and verify their absence in clear text in the collected logs and telemetry.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Log scan report (0 sensitive data in clear text detected) + configuration of the redaction/masking rule.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = clean scan on a representative sample + active and tested redaction rule ; partial = redaction active but incomplete on certain fields ; non-compliant = sensitive data found in clear text in the logs or telemetry
actions_audit: Inject a canary secret and a test PII into an application journey, then scan the resulting logs and telemetry.
Verify the configuration of the redaction/masking rule and its coverage of the known sensitive fields.
If a gap is found: extend the redaction to the missing fields and purge the occurrences already logged.
standards: ISO/IEC 27002:2022 — 8.12 (prévention de la fuite de données)

constraints.regle: The health of each critical dependency and exchange flow (latency, error rate, volume, queue depth) is monitored automatically, with thresholds declared per flow enabling detection before end-user impact.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of dedicated monitoring of the critical exchange flows (latency, errors, volume, queue depth) and the declaration of thresholds per flow.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Monitoring dashboard of the critical flows + declared thresholds + history of a degradation alert.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = critical flows monitored with declared thresholds and tested escalation ; partial = partial monitoring or uncalibrated thresholds ; non-compliant = no dedicated monitoring of dependencies
actions_audit: List the critical dependencies and exchange flows and verify the existence of dedicated monitoring.
Verify the declaration of thresholds per flow and the history of at least one degradation alert.
If a gap is found: instrument the unmonitored flows and calibrate the missing thresholds.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion des événements

constraints.regle: For any feature based on a generative or predictive artificial intelligence model, the quality of the responses produced is monitored continuously (canary sample, comparison to a reference) in order to detect any drift in the model or prompts.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of continuous monitoring of AI response quality (daily canary, comparison to a reference dataset) and the trace of a drift detection.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Configuration of the AI quality monitoring + history of quality scores over a representative period + trace of a drift alert if applicable.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = continuous AI quality monitoring with tested drift detection ; partial = one-off evaluation without continuous tracking ; non-compliant = no evaluation of AI response quality
actions_audit: Verify the existence of a reference dataset and a periodic (canary) run comparing the responses produced.
Verify the trace of a drift detection (model update, prompt drift) and the associated response.
If a gap is found: implement the continuous evaluation and define the drift threshold triggering an alert.
standards: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (surveillance opérationnelle des systèmes de management de l'IA)

constraints.regle: Security events (authentication, privilege escalation, access to secrets and sensitive data) are logged in a central repository; access to this repository is itself restricted to a dedicated role and logged.
constraints.verification: Verify the catalog of security events logged systematically and the restriction/logging of access to the log repository itself.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Excerpt of the catalog of logged security events + excerpt of the access log for the log repository.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = complete event catalog and repository access restricted and logged ; partial = incomplete catalog or unrestricted access ; non-compliant = security events not distinguished from generic application logs
actions_audit: Verify the coverage of the catalog of logged security events (authentication, escalation, sensitive access).
Verify the access restriction to the log repository and the logging of that access.
If a gap is found: complete the event catalog and restrict access to the dedicated role.
standards: NIST SP 800-53 — famille AU (Audit and Accountability)

constraints.regle: The volume and cost of telemetry (logs, metrics, traces) are governed by a proportionate sampling, cardinality, and retention policy, with regular budget tracking.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a telemetry sampling/cardinality policy and its alignment with a cost budget tracked periodically.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Documented sampling/cardinality policy + cost history of the telemetry platform over 90 days.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = policy declared and cost tracked within the allocated budget ; partial = cost tracked without a formalized sampling policy ; non-compliant = telemetry volume neither controlled nor tracked
actions_audit: Extract the cost history of the telemetry platform over 90 days and compare it to the allocated budget.
Verify the existence of a sampling or cardinality policy limiting the volume collected.
If a gap is found: define the sampling policy and the corresponding tracking budget.

constraints.regle: The level of compliance with the WCAG 2.2 level AA success criteria (or the applicable local accessibility standards package) is measured through a tooled and documented audit, with a remediation plan for any unmet criterion.
constraints.verification: Run a tooled accessibility audit covering the full set of WCAG 2.2 level AA success criteria (or the declared local standards package) on the main journeys, and verify the existence of a remediation plan for the gaps.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Dated accessibility audit report (score per success criterion) + remediation plan for the identified gaps.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% of the AA criteria met or documented waiver ; partial = gaps identified with a dated remediation plan ; non-compliant = no accessibility audit performed or gaps without a remediation plan
actions_audit: Run (or have replayed) a tooled accessibility audit on the main journeys and collect the score per success criterion.
Verify the existence of a dated remediation plan for each unmet criterion.
If a gap is found: prioritize the remediation according to the criterion's criticality (blocking for use vs. comfort).
standards: WCAG 2.2 — niveau AA (ensemble des critères de succès)

constraints.regle: All functional journeys are fully operable with the keyboard alone, without a focus trap, with a visible focus indicator at every step.
constraints.verification: Walk through the declared critical journeys using only the keyboard (tab, enter, escape) and verify the absence of a focus trap and the continuous visibility of the focus indicator.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Recording or report of the keyboard navigation on each critical journey, with the blocking points identified.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = all critical journeys operable with the keyboard, focus always visible ; partial = secondary journeys not operable with the keyboard ; non-compliant = focus trap or element unreachable by keyboard on a critical journey
actions_audit: Replay each declared critical journey using keyboard-only navigation.
Verify the absence of a focus trap and the continuous visibility of the focus indicator.
If a gap is found: fix the tab order or the components inaccessible by keyboard.

constraints.regle: The color contrasts of text and significant interface elements meet the required minimum ratios, verified with a contrast measurement tool across the full set of screens in the style guide.
constraints.verification: Measure the contrast ratio of text and significant interface elements (icons, input fields) on each representative screen of the style guide, using a contrast measurement tool.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Contrast measurement report per representative screen, with the ratios obtained against the required threshold.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = all ratios measured above the required threshold ; partial = gaps limited to non-essential elements ; non-compliant = essential text or element below the required threshold
actions_audit: Measure the contrast ratio on each representative screen (normal text, large text, non-text elements).
Isolate the elements below the required threshold and assess how essential they are to the journey.
If a gap is found: adjust the style guide's color palette for the affected elements.

constraints.regle: The interface adapts without loss of functionality or readability to the screen widths and interaction modes (touch, mouse, keyboard) of the declared target devices.
constraints.verification: Verify the rendering and operability of the main journeys on each declared target device (desktop, tablet, mobile), in portrait and landscape modes where applicable.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Screenshots of the main journeys on each target device + record of the layout breakpoints.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = main journeys operable and readable on all target devices ; partial = layout breakage limited to secondary screens ; non-compliant = critical journey inoperable on a declared target device
actions_audit: List the declared target devices and verify the rendering of the main journeys on each.
Identify the layout breakpoints or points of functionality loss.
If a gap is found: fix the breakpoints and extend the tests to the uncovered devices.

constraints.regle: The performance perceived by the user (initial load time, responsiveness to interactions, visual stability) is measured with a generic web or mobile performance measurement tool, on the main journeys.
constraints.verification: Run a generic performance measurement tool on the main journeys and record the perceived performance indicators (initial load, responsiveness, visual stability) in a representative environment.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Perceived performance measurement report per journey, with the values obtained against the declared target thresholds.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = perceived performance indicators under the target thresholds on all main journeys ; partial = overrun limited to secondary journeys ; non-compliant = no measurement performed or thresholds exceeded on a main journey
actions_audit: Run the perceived performance measurement on each main journey in an environment representative of the target load.
Compare the indicators obtained to the declared target thresholds.
If a gap is found: identify the optimization areas (resource weight, server response time) and prioritize addressing them.

constraints.regle: Every critical functional journey is tested with representative users before broad rollout, and the observed friction points are subject to a correction plan.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of user test sessions on each declared critical journey, with participants representative of the target personas, and the existence of a correction plan for the observed friction points.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Report of the user test sessions (participants, journeys tested, friction points observed) + dated correction plan.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = all critical journeys tested with representative users and correction plan tracked ; partial = tests performed on part of the critical journeys ; non-compliant = no user test performed
actions_audit: Verify the coverage of the user test sessions against the critical journeys declared in D00.
Assess the representativeness of the participants against the target personas.
If a gap is found: schedule the missing test sessions and track the correction plan for the friction points already observed.

constraints.regle: Every error message presented to the user identifies the nature of the problem and proposes a concrete resolution or workaround action, without exposing internal technical detail.
constraints.verification: Trigger the common user errors on the main journeys (invalid input, network failure, insufficient rights) and verify that each message identifies the problem and proposes a concrete action.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Captures of the error messages obtained for each scenario tested, with an assessment of how actionable they are.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = all messages tested identify the problem and propose a concrete action ; partial = generic messages without a proposed action on certain scenarios ; non-compliant = raw technical message or absence of a message shown to the user
actions_audit: Trigger the common error scenarios on the main journeys and collect the messages shown.
Assess each message against two criteria: problem identification, concrete action proposed.
If a gap is found: rephrase the generic or technical messages into actionable messages.

constraints.regle: A mechanism for collecting user feedback (satisfaction, friction, suggestion) is in place on an ongoing basis, and the feedback collected feeds a prioritized improvement backlog.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a user feedback collection mechanism active on an ongoing basis and its traceability to a prioritized improvement backlog.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Export of the user feedback collected over a representative period + excerpt of the corresponding improvement backlog.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = collection mechanism active on an ongoing basis and feedback tracked in a prioritized backlog ; partial = one-off collection without traceability to a backlog ; non-compliant = no user feedback collection mechanism
actions_audit: Verify the existence and ongoing activity of the user feedback collection mechanism.
Trace a sample of collected feedback through to its handling in the improvement backlog.
If a gap is found: implement the collection mechanism and its connection with the product backlog.

constraints.regle: Routine operational tasks (start/stop, deployment, purge, rotation, scheduled jobs) are described in up-to-date runbooks, executable by a person unfamiliar with the application code.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of runbooks covering the declared routine operational tasks and have a procedure executed by a person outside the development team.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Documented runbooks for each routine operation + execution report by a third-party person.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = complete runbooks successfully executed by a third-party person ; partial = partial runbooks or requiring assistance from the development team ; non-compliant = routine operations not documented
actions_audit: List the routine operational tasks and verify the existence of a runbook for each.
Have a representative procedure executed by a person outside the development team.
If gap: draft the missing runbooks and correct the procedures that required assistance.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion des opérations informatiques

constraints.regle: A formalized incident procedure covers detection, escalation (including the breakage of an integration pipeline or the breach of an error budget threshold) and on-call mobilization, with a bounded and measured response time.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a documented incident and on-call procedure, covering the detection-escalation-mobilization chain, and measure the response time on a real or simulated incident.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Documented incident and on-call procedure + response time measurement from an exercise or a real incident.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = documented procedure, operational on-call, response time measured and met ; partial = documented procedure without time measurement ; non-compliant = absence of a formalized incident or on-call procedure
actions_audit: Verify the existence of the incident procedure and the on-call chain (rotation, contacts, escalation).
Measure the response time on a simulated exercise or the latest real incident.
If gap: formalize the missing procedure and schedule a trigger exercise.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion des incidents

constraints.regle: Each application has a justified criticality classification (e.g. S1 to S4) and a declared service level agreement (SLA) consistent with this criticality.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a justified criticality classification and a declared SLA consistent with this classification (service hours, target availability, response times).
constraints.preuve_attendue: Justified criticality classification sheet + declared SLA document.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = justified classification and consistent SLA formally declared ; partial = declared classification without justification or incomplete SLA ; non-compliant = no classification or SLA declared
actions_audit: Verify the declared criticality classification and its justification with regard to business impact.
Verify the consistency of the declared SLA with the chosen classification.
If gap: establish or correct the classification and align the corresponding SLA.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion des niveaux de service

constraints.regle: Incidents are managed using a dedicated tool (tracking, history, actions) and every significant incident is subject to a blameless post-mortem, including a documented rollback exercise where relevant.
constraints.verification: Verify the use of an incident management tool and the existence of documented post-mortems for significant incidents over the last 12 months, including the measurement of restoration time.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Extract from the incident management tool + sample of documented post-mortems with measured restoration time.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = tool in place, systematic post-mortems with measured restoration time ; partial = tool in place, partial or informal post-mortems ; non-compliant = incidents not tracked or no post-mortem performed
actions_audit: Verify the effective use of the incident management tool over the last 12 months.
Sample the post-mortems performed and verify the measurement of restoration time and the absence of individual blame.
If gap: instrument the missing tracking and systematize the post-mortem for every significant incident.

constraints.regle: Each production asset has a documented responsibility matrix (RACI), with at least two people actually capable of intervening in operations (bus factor ≥ 2), and the matrix is reviewed at least once a year.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a RACI matrix per production asset, the identification of at least two real operators per critical asset, and the date of the matrix's last review.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Timestamped export of the RACI matrix + report of the last review (< 12 months).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = complete matrix, bus factor ≥ 2 verified and reviewed < 12 months ago ; partial = complete matrix but bus factor = 1 on some assets or overdue review ; non-compliant = at least one asset without an identified owner
actions_audit: Extract the RACI matrix and verify that no production asset is without an identified Accountable.
Verify, by sampling, that each critical asset has at least two genuinely operational responders.
If gap: complete the matrix and organize knowledge transfer to a second responder.
standards: COBIT 2019 (composant Structures organisationnelles — RACI par pratique)

constraints.regle: A tolerated data loss objective (RPO) and restoration time objective (RTO) is declared for each critical asset, and the restoration capability is periodically tested with proof of compliance.
constraints.verification: Verify the RPO/RTO declaration per critical asset and the record of the last real restoration exercise, with measurement of the duration and integrity of the restored data.
constraints.preuve_attendue: RPO/RTO declared per asset + report of the last restoration exercise (duration, observed integrity).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = RPO/RTO declared and restoration successfully tested within the last 12 months ; partial = objectives declared without a recent test ; non-compliant = no declared objectives or last test failed and not corrected
actions_audit: Verify the RPO/RTO declaration for each critical asset and its consistency with business tolerance.
Verify the report of the last real restoration exercise (duration achieved, observed integrity).
If gap: declare the missing objectives and schedule a restoration exercise.

constraints.regle: A business continuity plan covers major disaster scenarios (site loss, prolonged unavailability of a critical supplier) with defined roles, a crisis communication procedure and periodic testing.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a continuity plan covering the applicable major disaster scenarios, the designation of crisis roles, and the date of the last test or exercise.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Documented continuity plan + report of the last continuity test or exercise.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = documented plan covering the applicable scenarios and tested within the last 12 months ; partial = documented plan without a recent test ; non-compliant = no formalized continuity plan
actions_audit: Verify the continuity plan's coverage with regard to the disaster scenarios applicable to the application.
Verify the designation of crisis roles and the existence of a communication procedure.
If gap: complete the plan and schedule a test exercise.
standards: ISO/IEC 27002:2022 — 5.29 (sécurité de l'information pendant une perturbation)

constraints.regle: Operational access to production (deployment, on-call intervention, emergency access) is named, traced, and the emergency access mode ("break-glass") is documented and logged when used.
constraints.verification: Verify that production operational access is named, the existence of a documented emergency access procedure, and the logging of its actual use.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Inventory of production operational access + emergency access procedure + extract from the usage log of this procedure.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = named access, emergency procedure documented and logged ; partial = named access without a formalized emergency procedure ; non-compliant = shared or untraced access
actions_audit: Inventory the accounts with production operational access and verify that they are named.
Verify the existence of the emergency access procedure and, if it has been used, the trace left behind.
If gap: assign names to shared access and formalize the missing emergency procedure.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion des accès

constraints.regle: The transfer of the application to the operations team (RUN) is formalized through a complete application handover file, the registration of the service in the inventory repository, and a traced handover between the owner and the RUN team.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a complete application handover file, the actual registration of the service in the inventory repository, and the record of a formal handover between the owner and the RUN team.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Application handover file + extract from the inventory repository + dated and signed handover report.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = complete file, service referenced, handover traced and signed ; partial = incomplete file or service not referenced ; non-compliant = no handover file or formalized handover
actions_audit: Verify the completeness of the application handover file against the expected reference framework.
Verify the registration of the service in the inventory repository and its freshness.
If gap: complete the missing file and schedule the formal handover with the RUN team.

constraints.regle: A security incident response procedure is defined, tested and tooled: detection, qualification, containment, evidence preservation, lessons learned.
constraints.verification: Verify the response procedure (roles, channels, steps), the record of an exercise or a handled incident, and the evidence preservation capability (protected logs, freeze).
constraints.preuve_attendue: Procedure + exercise/incident report + preservation proof (configuration).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = procedure tested with preservable evidence ; partial = procedure not tested ; non-compliant = no response procedure
actions_audit: Collect the procedure and the last exercise; attach them.
Verify the link with tamper-proof logging (CTL-D03-08) for the evidence.
If gap: formalize the procedure, schedule an exercise, tool the preservation.

constraints.regle: Each application repository carries an operational README describing the project's purpose, prerequisites, start/test/deployment commands and points of contact, kept up to date with each structural change.
constraints.verification: Verify the presence and completeness of the README (purpose, prerequisites, essential commands, contacts) and its consistency with the actual state of the project.
constraints.preuve_attendue: README content + verification that the documented commands actually execute.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = complete, up-to-date README, commands verified functional ; partial = README present but incomplete or partially outdated ; non-compliant = README absent or reduced to a title
actions_audit: Verify the presence of the expected README sections (purpose, prerequisites, startup, deployment, contacts).
Execute the documented commands and verify their success.
If gap: complete the missing sections and correct the outdated commands.

constraints.regle: Every exposed API publishes an explicit interface contract (e.g. open specification), versioned, synchronized with the actual implementation and automatically verified in continuous integration.
constraints.verification: Verify the publication of an interface contract for each exposed API, its explicit versioning, and the existence of an automated contract/implementation compliance check in CI.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Published and versioned interface contract + contract/implementation compliance report generated by the pipeline.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = contract published, versioned and automatically verified in CI ; partial = contract published but not automatically verified ; non-compliant = absence of an explicit interface contract
actions_audit: Verify the publication and versioning of the interface contract for each exposed API.
Verify the execution of an automated contract/implementation compliance check in CI.
If gap: publish the missing contract and tool the automated verification.

constraints.regle: Significant architecture decisions are recorded in an active decision register (ADR): each decision carries an identifier and a frontmatter compliant with the corpus schema, and no decision with accepted status is substantively rewritten outside of a status change or an explicit succession link.
constraints.verification: Verify that the decision register covers recent structural choices, that each entry complies with the expected identifier and frontmatter schema, and that no accepted entry has been substantively modified without the creation of a replacement decision.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Extract from the decision register + output from the format checker + version history demonstrating the absence of rewriting of an accepted decision.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = active register, 0 format anomalies, no substantive rewriting detected ; partial = active register with minor anomalies or missing decisions on recent choices ; non-compliant = register absent or accepted decision rewritten without traceability
actions_audit: Verify the decision register's coverage against the structural choices identified in D01.
Run the format checker on the register and note the anomalies.
If gap: complete the register for the missing decisions and correct the format anomalies.
standards: MADR 4.0.0 (gabarit et cycle de vie des décisions)

constraints.regle: Technical architecture documentation (diagrams, adopted principles, register of gaps relative to the target) is kept up to date and accessible to all the teams concerned.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence and freshness of the technical architecture documentation and the register of gaps relative to the documented target architecture.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Technical architecture diagrams and documents + register of gaps with remediation status.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = up-to-date documentation and gap register maintained, all justified ; partial = documentation present but partially outdated or not all gaps justified ; non-compliant = absence of technical architecture documentation or gap register
actions_audit: Compare the technical architecture documentation to the actual implementation and note the discrepancies.
Verify that every gap appears in the register with a remediation status.
If gap: update the documentation and complete the gap register.
standards: TOGAF ADM — Phase G (gouvernance de la mise en œuvre)

constraints.regle: User documentation covering the main features is published, accessible from the application or its associated portal, and kept up to date with delivered functional changes.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence, accessibility and freshness of the user documentation with regard to the main features delivered.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Extract from the user documentation (last update date, functional coverage) + access verified from the application.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = user documentation accessible and up to date across all main features ; partial = partial or outdated documentation ; non-compliant = absence of user documentation
actions_audit: Verify the user documentation's coverage against the declared main features.
Verify the accessibility of the documentation from the application or its associated portal.
If gap: complete or update the missing user documentation.

constraints.regle: An onboarding guide enables a new developer to obtain a functional environment and make their first contribution autonomously, without systematically needing help from the existing team.
constraints.verification: Have the onboarding guide followed by a person who has never worked on the project and measure the time and number of requests for help needed to obtain a functional environment.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Documented onboarding guide + report of a test onboarding (duration, help requests needed).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = functional environment obtained autonomously in less than one day ; partial = onboarding achievable with a few occasional requests for help ; non-compliant = onboarding impossible without continuous team assistance
actions_audit: Have the onboarding guide followed by a person outside the project and time the result.
Note the blocking points that required a request for help from the existing team.
If gap: complete the guide on the identified blocking points.

constraints.regle: A data dictionary describing entities, attributes and business meanings is published in a referenced catalog, discoverable and searchable by business meaning rather than by technical structure alone.
constraints.verification: Verify the publication of a data dictionary in a referenced catalog, its coverage of the entities in production, and the possibility of searching it by business meaning.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Extract from the data catalog showing the coverage and freshness of the dictionary's descriptions.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = dictionary published, up to date, covering all entities in production and searchable by business meaning ; partial = incomplete coverage or search by business meaning absent ; non-compliant = absence of a referenced data dictionary
actions_audit: Verify the data dictionary's coverage against the entities in production.
Test the search for an entity by its business meaning in the catalog.
If gap: complete the dictionary and publish the missing entities in the referenced catalog.

constraints.regle: Applicable compliance documentation (impact assessments, register of processing activities, regulatory classifications, control evidence) is centralized, referenced from the project documentation and kept up to date with each significant change.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence and accessibility of the applicable compliance documentation, its reference from the project documentation, and its update following the last significant change.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Inventory of the applicable compliance documentation + proof of update following the project's last significant change.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = compliance documentation complete, referenced and up to date ; partial = documentation existing but not referenced or partially outdated ; non-compliant = compliance documentation absent for an applicable obligation
actions_audit: List the applicable compliance obligations and verify the existence of the corresponding documentation.
Verify the reference to this documentation from the project documentation and its last update date.
If gap: produce the missing documentation and establish its update process.
standards: ISO/IEC 27002:2022 — 5.36 (conformité aux politiques, règles et normes)
RGPD — art. 30 (registre des activités de traitement)

constraints.regle: All project documentation (README, API doc, technical doc, ADR) is versioned in the same repository or a linked repository, reviewed via a change proposal like the code, and automatically published with each accepted change.
constraints.verification: Verify that the documentation is versioned under source control, reviewed through a change proposal mechanism, and automatically published after merging, with a synchronization timestamp.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Documentation version history + automated publishing configuration + timestamp of the last synchronization.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = documentation versioned, systematic review, publication synchronized in under 24 hours ; partial = versioned and reviewed but manual publication or documented latency ; non-compliant = documentation not versioned or edited outside the review flow
actions_audit: Verify that the documentation is stored under version control and goes through a review before merging.
Verify the configuration and freshness of the documentation's automated publishing.
If gap: migrate the remaining documentation to the versioned repository and tool the automatic publishing.

constraints.regle: The choice of each AI model used (provider, size, version) is justified by documented criteria (cost, performance, latency, sovereignty) and validated by a designated authority before going into production.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of a model selection note per AI use case, listing the alternatives considered, the selection criteria, and the validation by the designated authority.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Documented model selection note (alternatives, criteria, decision) + validation record.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = choice documented and validated for all models in production ; partial = choice documented without a recorded validation ; non-compliant = model in production without documented justification
actions_audit: List the AI models used in production and their associated use case.
Request the selection note and its validation for each model.
If gap: document the choice retroactively and have it validated by the designated authority.
standards: DAMA-DMBOK2 — Chapitre 3 (Data Governance, par extension à la gouvernance des modèles)

constraints.regle: Prompts (system, user, templates) are versioned in a dedicated registry, outside of the frozen application code, with a tracked change history and verification before publication.
constraints.verification: Verify that the prompts are externalized from the compiled code, versioned (registry, versioned files or prompt manager), and that each change is tracked with a review before deployment to production.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Extract from the prompt registry with version history + review record of the last published change.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = prompts versioned outside the code, tracked history, review before publication ; partial = prompts versioned without a formalized review ; non-compliant = prompts hardcoded in the code without versioning
actions_audit: Identify the location of the prompts (code, configuration file, dedicated registry).
Verify the version history of the last significant prompt change and its review.
If gap: externalize the prompts and set up versioning and review.

constraints.regle: The response quality of each model in production is continuously measured using a representative evaluation set (canary) and declared metrics, against explicit thresholds.
constraints.verification: Verify the existence of an evaluation set representative of the use case, declared quality metrics (accuracy, relevance, format) with thresholds, and the actual execution frequency of the evaluation.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Evaluation set (canary) + definition of metrics and thresholds + history of executions and results.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = regular automated evaluation with documented and met metrics/thresholds ; partial = one-off evaluation or unformalized thresholds ; non-compliant = absence of quality evaluation
actions_audit: Request the representative evaluation set and the definition of metrics/thresholds.
Verify the frequency and results of the latest evaluation runs.
If gap: build the evaluation set and automate its periodic execution.

constraints.regle: The inputs and outputs of each model are filtered by guardrails (dangerous content, personal data, prompt injection attempts) before being transmitted to the user or the downstream system.
constraints.verification: Verify the configuration of the content filters (input and output), test a prompt injection attempt and a request for sensitive content, and confirm that they are blocked or flagged.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Content filter configuration + result of a prompt injection test and a sensitive content request test.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = active filtering on input and output, bypass tests blocked ; partial = partial filtering (input or output only) ; non-compliant = absence of guardrails or successful bypass
actions_audit: Inspect the input and output guardrail configuration of the model(s) in production.
Replay a prompt injection test and a personal data request; verify that they are blocked.
If gap: activate or strengthen the missing guardrails and document the coverage achieved.
standards: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025 — LLM01 (Prompt Injection), LLM06 (Sensitive Information Disclosure)
RGPD — art. 25 (protection des données dès la conception)

constraints.regle: The hallucination rate (responses not grounded in the sources or incorrect) of each model in production is measured, bounded by a declared acceptability threshold, and is subject to a reduction plan in case of breach.
constraints.verification: Verify the hallucination detection method (comparison against sources, LLM-as-judge, user feedback), the declared acceptability threshold, and the history of measurements against this threshold.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Method and history of hallucination rate measurement + declared threshold + reduction plan in case of breach.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = rate continuously measured, below the declared threshold, reduction plan in place in case of breach ; partial = one-off measurement or unformalized threshold ; non-compliant = no measurement of the hallucination rate
actions_audit: Request the hallucination rate measurement method and its recent history.
Compare the measured rate to the declared acceptability threshold.
If gap: instrument the measurement and define the threshold and the associated reduction plan.
standards: NIST AI RMF 1.0 — fonction Measure (fiabilité, exactitude)

constraints.regle: A fallback strategy (backup model, degraded response, human escalation) is defined and tested for cases of unavailability, quota reached, or content refusal by the primary model.
constraints.verification: Verify the documentation of the fallback strategy and its actual triggering during a simulated unavailability test of the primary model (switchover to the backup model or controlled degradation).
constraints.preuve_attendue: Fallback strategy documentation + result of a switchover test (simulated unavailability).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = strategy documented and successfully tested ≤ 12 months ago ; partial = strategy documented without a recent test ; non-compliant = absence of a fallback strategy
actions_audit: Request the documentation of the fallback strategy (backup model, degradation, escalation).
Simulate an unavailability of the primary model and verify the switchover behavior.
If gap: define the missing fallback strategy and schedule a switchover test.
standards: DORA (Accelerate) — reprise de service (par analogie de résilience)

constraints.regle: The consumption and inference cost of each model in production are continuously monitored, with alerts on consumption drift thresholds.
constraints.verification: Verify the instrumentation of consumption tracking (tokens, calls, cost) per model and use case, and the existence of alerts configured on threshold breaches.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Dashboard or export of consumption/inference cost per model + threshold alert configuration.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = continuous tracking per model with active threshold alerts ; partial = tracking in place without configured alerts ; non-compliant = absence of consumption tracking
actions_audit: Extract the consumption/inference cost tracking per model over the recent period.
Verify the configuration of the consumption drift threshold alerts.
If gap: instrument the missing tracking and configure the alerts.

constraints.regle: Any interaction classified as sensitive (risky content, decision impacting a person, low model confidence) triggers a human review before final action or transmission.
constraints.verification: Verify the classification criteria triggering a human review, and test a case classified as sensitive to confirm the interruption of the automatic flow and the escalation to a human reviewer.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Documented classification criteria + record of a real or simulated case escalated to human review.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = criteria documented and systematic escalation verified ; partial = criteria documented without proven systematic escalation ; non-compliant = absence of a human review mechanism
actions_audit: Request the classification criteria triggering human review.
Replay a simulated sensitive case and verify the actual escalation to a human reviewer.
If gap: define the missing criteria and instrument the escalation.

constraints.regle: Every interaction with an AI model (prompt, context, response, decision metadata) is logged in a usable way, to allow the retrospective audit of a contested response.
constraints.verification: Select a recent interaction and verify that it can be found in the logs with the complete prompt, the response, the model used, and the timestamp.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Log extract of a recent AI interaction (prompt, response, model, timestamp).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% of interactions logged and usable for the audit ; partial = partial logging (sampling or missing fields) ; non-compliant = interactions not logged
actions_audit: Choose a recent AI interaction and search for it in the application logs.
Verify the presence of all the fields necessary for the audit (prompt, response, model, timestamp).
If gap: complete the missing logging instrumentation.

constraints.regle: The Data by Design principles pack applicable to the project defines an ownership principle (named business owner per data domain); this principle is formally adopted and its application is verifiable on the audited scope.
constraints.verification: Verify that the profile's Data by Design principles pack defines an ownership principle, then check, for a sample of data domains within the scope, the actual presence of a named owner in compliance with this principle.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Extract from the principles pack (definition of the ownership principle) + sample of data domains with a named owner.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = principle defined in the pack and applied to 100% of the checked sample ; partial = principle defined but partial application ; non-compliant = principle absent from the pack or not applied
actions_audit: Verify that the profile's Data by Design principles pack covers ownership.
Sample data domains within the scope and verify the presence of a named owner.
If gap: have the principles pack completed or have the missing owners designated.
standards: RGPD — art. 24 (responsabilité du responsable de traitement)

constraints.regle: The Data by Design principles pack defines a validated modeling principle (review by a data authority before going into production); this principle is applied to every data model delivered within the audited scope.
constraints.verification: Verify that the principles pack covers modeling validation, then check that a sample of recently delivered data models bears a record of review by the data authority before going into production.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Extract from the pack (validated modeling principle) + review reports for a sample of delivered models.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = principle defined and review recorded for 100% of the sample ; partial = principle defined with partially recorded reviews ; non-compliant = principle absent or no review recorded
actions_audit: Verify that the principles pack covers validated modeling.
Sample recently delivered data models and verify the record of review by the data authority.
If gap: have the pack completed or establish the missing modeling review.
standards: ISO/IEC 25012:2008 — modèle de qualité des données

constraints.regle: The Data by Design principles pack defines a measured quality principle (declared rules and thresholds, continuous control); this principle is applied to the critical data domains within the audited scope.
