constraints.verification: Verify that the principles pack covers measured quality, then check that a sample of critical domains actually applies quality rules with thresholds and continuous execution.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Extract from the pack (measured quality principle) + sample of rules/thresholds applied per critical domain.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = principle defined and applied to 100% of the critical sample ; partial = partial application ; non-compliant = principle absent or not applied
actions_audit: Verify that the principles pack covers measured quality.
Sample critical domains and verify the actual application of quality rules with thresholds.
If gap: have the pack completed or instrument the missing quality rules.
standards: ISO/IEC 25012:2008 — modèle de qualité des données

constraints.regle: The Data by Design principles pack defines a data protection by design principle (classification, minimization, proportionate measures); this principle is applied to every personal or sensitive data domain within the audited scope.
constraints.verification: Verify that the principles pack covers protection by design, then check that a sample of domains processing personal or sensitive data bears a classification and proportionate protection measures.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Extract from the pack (privacy by design principle) + sample of classifications and protection measures applied.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = principle defined and proportionate measures applied to 100% of the sample ; partial = classification present without complete measures ; non-compliant = principle absent or sensitive data not classified
actions_audit: Verify that the principles pack covers data protection by design.
Sample domains processing personal/sensitive data and verify classification and measures.
If gap: have the pack completed or apply the missing protection measures.
standards: RGPD — art. 25 (protection des données dès la conception et par défaut)

constraints.regle: The Data by Design principles pack defines a native usability principle (every data domain is exposed via a published, integrable data contract); this principle is applied to domains intended for cross-functional sharing.
constraints.verification: Verify that the principles pack covers native usability, then check that a sample of cross-functionally shared domains publishes an up-to-date data contract.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Extract from the pack (usability principle) + sample of published data contracts.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = principle defined and contract published for 100% of the shared sample ; partial = partial or outdated contracts ; non-compliant = principle absent or no contract published
actions_audit: Verify that the principles pack covers native usability.
Sample cross-functionally shared domains and verify the publication of an up-to-date data contract.
If gap: have the pack completed or publish the missing data contracts.

constraints.regle: The Data by Design principles pack defines an observability principle (monitoring of freshness, volume, and lineage); this principle is applied to the critical data domains within the audited scope.
constraints.verification: Verify that the principles pack covers data observability, then check that a sample of critical domains has active monitoring (alerting, viewable lineage).
constraints.preuve_attendue: Extract from the pack (observability principle) + monitoring captures (alerting, lineage) for the sample.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = principle defined and active monitoring on 100% of the critical sample ; partial = partial monitoring ; non-compliant = principle absent or no monitoring
actions_audit: Verify that the principles pack covers data observability.
Sample critical domains and verify the existence of active monitoring (alerting, lineage).
If gap: have the pack completed or instrument the missing monitoring.
standards: ISO 8000-8 — qualité de l'information : concepts et mesure

constraints.regle: The Data by Design principles pack defines a knowledge and cataloging principle (every asset in production is described and discoverable); this principle is applied to the data assets in production within the audited scope.
constraints.verification: Verify that the principles pack covers cataloging, then check the coverage and freshness of the descriptions of a sample of assets in production in the catalog.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Extract from the pack (cataloging principle) + extract from the catalog showing coverage and freshness for the sample.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = principle defined and 100% of the sample cataloged and up to date ; partial = incomplete coverage ; non-compliant = principle absent or absence of a catalog
actions_audit: Verify that the principles pack covers cataloging and discoverability.
Sample assets in production and verify their presence and freshness in the catalog.
If gap: have the pack completed or catalog the missing assets.
standards: FAIR Principles (GO FAIR, 2016) — Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable

constraints.regle: The Data by Design principles pack defines a governed accessibility principle (traced and reviewed authorizations, access proportionate to classification); this principle is applied to the data domains within the audited scope.
constraints.verification: Verify that the principles pack covers governed accessibility, then check that a sample of domains has an authorization matrix that is traced and periodically reviewed.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Extract from the pack (governed accessibility principle) + authorization matrix and last review date for the sample.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = principle defined and matrix up to date (reviewed ≤ 12 months ago) for 100% of the sample ; partial = matrix existing without a recent review ; non-compliant = principle absent or absence of a matrix
actions_audit: Verify that the principles pack covers governed accessibility.
Sample data domains and verify the existence and freshness of the authorization matrix.
If gap: have the pack completed or update the missing authorization matrices.

constraints.regle: The Data by Design principles pack defines a sustainability principle (full lifecycle managed: retention, archiving, purging, proven restoration capability); this principle is applied to the critical data domains within the audited scope.
constraints.verification: Verify that the principles pack covers lifecycle sustainability, then check that a sample of critical domains applies a retention policy and has a tested restoration capability.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Extract from the pack (sustainability principle) + retention policies and latest restoration test reports for the sample.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = principle defined and lifecycle managed/proven for 100% of the sample ; partial = partial management (retention without restoration test, or vice versa) ; non-compliant = principle absent or lifecycle not managed
actions_audit: Verify that the principles pack covers sustainability and the data lifecycle.
Sample critical domains and verify the retention policy and restoration test.
If gap: have the pack completed or establish the missing lifecycle management.

constraints.regle: All tables, views and relationships of the database are inventoried and documented (ERD or equivalent), kept up to date with each significant schema change.
constraints.verification: Compare the ERD or documented model with the actual schema introspection (information_schema or equivalent) to verify the completeness and freshness of the inventory.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Up-to-date ERD/CDM/LDM + extract of the actual schema introspection for comparison.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = exhaustive and up-to-date inventory, consistent with the actual schema ; partial = existing inventory with minor discrepancies or outdated ; non-compliant = absence of an inventory or major discrepancies with the actual schema
actions_audit: Obtain the ERD or the documented data model and the last update date.
Compare with an introspection of the actual schema (tables, columns, relationships).
If gap: update the inventory and schedule its synchronization with each migration.
standards: ISO/IEC 25012:2008 — modèle de qualité des données

constraints.regle: Each table carries a declared primary key; each logical relationship between tables is implemented by an effective foreign key constraint, with no unconstrained logical reference.
constraints.verification: Introspect the actual schema to list the declared primary and foreign keys; search for reference columns (logical identifier) not covered by an integrity constraint.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Introspection extract (pg_constraint or equivalent) listing declared PK/FK + list of identified unconstrained logical references.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% of tables with a PK and logical relationships covered by FK ; partial = a few unconstrained logical references, documented and justified ; non-compliant = absence of a PK on a table or a significant number of unconstrained logical relationships
actions_audit: Extract the list of declared primary and foreign keys on the actual schema.
Search for logical reference columns (for example, an _id suffix) not covered by an FK constraint.
If gap: add the missing constraints or document and justify the exceptions.

constraints.regle: The indexes in place are aligned with the queries actually executed in production (filters, joins, frequent sorts); their relevance is verified via the execution plan.
constraints.verification: Compare the indexes declared on the schema against the most frequent or most costly queries observed in production, and verify via the execution plan (EXPLAIN) the absence of an avoidable full scan.
constraints.preuve_attendue: List of declared indexes + execution plans of frequent/costly queries showing their actual use.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = frequent/costly queries covered by a relevant index, verified via the execution plan ; partial = partial coverage or a few avoidable full scans ; non-compliant = absence of an index on major access paths or no verification via the execution plan
actions_audit: Identify the most frequent or most costly queries in production (slow query log or equivalent).
Run the execution plan of these queries and verify the actual use of a relevant index.
If gap: create or adjust the missing indexes and re-verify the execution plan.

constraints.regle: Each column carrying personal or sensitive data is individually identified and classified, with protection measures proportionate to its classification level.
constraints.verification: Review the data dictionary and the actual schema to identify the columns containing personal or sensitive data; verify the declared classification and the actual protection measures (encryption, masking, access control) for a sample.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Classification of sensitive columns (register or annotated dictionary) + sample of verified protection measures.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% of sensitive columns classified with measures compliant with the declared level ; partial = partial classification or incomplete measures ; non-compliant = personal/sensitive columns not identified
actions_audit: Review each table in the schema to identify personal or sensitive columns.
Verify the declared classification and sample the protection measures actually applied.
If gap: classify the missing columns and apply the proportionate protection measures.

constraints.regle: The model declared on the application code side (ORM or equivalent) is aligned with the actual physical schema of the database; any drift is detected before going into production.
constraints.verification: Compare the ORM model declarations (tables, columns, types, constraints) with the introspection of the actual physical schema, and verify the existence of an automated check detecting drift before deployment.
constraints.preuve_attendue: ORM↔actual schema comparison report (last run) + configuration of the drift check in continuous integration, if it exists.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = alignment automatically verified with each deployment, no residual drift ; partial = alignment verified manually or minor drift documented ; non-compliant = drift not detected or not corrected between the ORM and the actual schema
actions_audit: Extract the declared ORM model and compare it to the introspection of the actual physical schema.
Verify the existence of an automated regression check on this alignment in continuous integration.
If gap: correct the observed drift and instrument the missing automated check.

constraints.regle: Every database schema change is applied through a versioned migration tool, with a tested rollback script for each migration.
constraints.verification: Verify the migration tooling used, the versioned history of applied migrations, and test the rollback of a recent migration in a non-production environment.
constraints.preuve_attendue: History of versioned migrations (tool, dates, authors) + result of a rollback test in a non-production environment.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = migrations tooled, versioned, rollback successfully tested ; partial = migrations versioned without a tested rollback ; non-compliant = ad hoc manual migrations not versioned
actions_audit: Extract the history of applied schema migrations and the tooling used.
Test the rollback of the last migration in a non-production environment.
If gap: tool the migrations and document/test the rollback procedure.

constraints.regle: A data dictionary describing each table and each column (business meaning, type, constraints, sensitivity) is kept up to date and accessible to non-creating teams.
constraints.verification: Verify the coverage and freshness of the data dictionary against the actual schema, and its accessibility to a team other than the one that created the schema.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Extract from the data dictionary + coverage rate of the tables/columns of the actual schema.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = dictionary covering 100% of the tables/columns in production, up to date, accessible ; partial = incomplete coverage or outdated dictionary ; non-compliant = absence of a data dictionary
actions_audit: Extract the existing data dictionary and its coverage rate against the actual schema.
Verify the last update date and the accessibility to non-creating teams.
If gap: complete the dictionary and schedule its update with each migration.

constraints.regle: The volume of each significant table is measured and its growth projected; a partitioning or lifecycle strategy is in place beyond the declared volume thresholds.
constraints.verification: Verify the current volume measurement and the growth projection of significant tables, and the existence of a partitioning or lifecycle strategy triggered beyond a declared threshold.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Volume measurements and growth projection per significant table + partitioning or lifecycle configuration if applicable.
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = volume measured, projection documented, partitioning/lifecycle strategy in place beyond the threshold ; partial = volume measured without a strategy beyond the threshold ; non-compliant = volume not measured
actions_audit: Extract the current volume and its growth history for significant tables.
Verify the existence of a declared threshold triggering partitioning or archiving.
If gap: measure the missing volume and define the partitioning/lifecycle strategy.

constraints.regle: The database is subject to regular backups compliant with a declared RPO, and the restoration procedure is periodically tested with proof of compliance with the RTO.
constraints.verification: Verify the declared RPO/RTO for the database, the actual frequency of backups, and the result of the last complete restoration exercise.
constraints.preuve_attendue: Declared RPO/RTO + backup configuration + report of the last restoration exercise (duration, integrity).
constraints.grille_verdict: compliant = RPO/RTO declared and met, restoration successfully tested ≤ 12 months ago ; partial = objectives declared without a recent test ; non-compliant = no declared objectives or last test failed and not corrected
actions_audit: Extract the declared RPO/RTO and the actual backup configuration of the database.
Verify the date and the result of the last complete restoration exercise.
If gap: declare the missing objectives and schedule a restoration test.
